title: Senior Website, SEO, AEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Senior Website, SEO, AEO & Digital Marketing Specialist



Construction Industry | Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Career Opportunity



We are seeking one exceptional professional-not simply filling another position.



Build Something That Matters



We are not looking for someone to maintain websites.



We are looking for an exceptional professional to help build one of the premier construction organizations in California and Nevada.



If you are driven by excellence, enjoy solving complex challenges, thrive on accountability, and want to build something that will last, we want to hear from you.



This is a long-term career opportunity—not freelance work, contract work, or a short-term project.



Who We Are



We own and operate multiple construction companies serving California and Nevada in:



* Commercial Construction

* Tenant Improvements

* Multi-Family Construction

* Single-Family Residential Construction

* Construction Management

* Owner's Representation

* Exterior Siding & Cladding

* Construction Consulting

* Litigation Support & Expert Witness Services



We are investing in technology, AI, standardized business systems, advanced project controls, and industry-leading operating procedures to support sustainable long-term growth.



Our mission is simple: "Become the benchmark by which others are measured."



Our Culture



We hire professionals who expect more from themselves than anyone else does.



Our culture is built on:



* Precision

* Accountability

* Professionalism

* Continuous Improvement

* Execution

* Measurable Results



We move with purpose.



We communicate clearly.



We solve problems.



We execute with discipline.



We compete to win.



Position Summary



You will work directly with executive leadership to design, build, optimize, and continuously improve the digital presence of multiple construction companies.



You will help build a marketing platform that generates qualified leads, strengthens our brands, and supports long-term growth.



Our long-term platform is "WordPress". Experience with "WIX" is important for supporting one of our current websites and assisting with planned migrations to WordPress.



Primary Responsibilities



* Design, develop, and optimize WordPress websites

* Support and migrate existing WIX website to WordPress

* Execute Technical SEO

* Execute Local SEO

* Implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

* Optimize Google Business Profiles

* Improve website performance, speed, and user experience

* Develop landing pages, service pages, and blog content

* Write compelling SEO-focused website copy

* Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns

* Manage LinkedIn,
, Google Business Profile, and related platforms

* Monitor Google Analytics and Google Search Console

* Develop measurable marketing dashboards and performance reports

* Assist with CRM selection, implementation, integration, and optimization

* Develop lead capture, follow-up, and marketing automation workflows

* Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve productivity, content quality, and marketing efficiency

* Maintain consistent branding across multiple companies



Minimum Qualifications



* Minimum "5 years" professional experience in website development, SEO, and digital marketing

* Advanced WordPress experience

* Experience with WIX

* Strong Technical SEO and Local SEO knowledge

* Google Analytics

* Google Search Console

* Google Business Profile optimization

* CRM experience

* Strong English writing and communication skills

* Excellent organizational skills

* Self-motivated with exceptional attention to detail

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously



Preferred Qualifications



* 7+ years experience

* Construction industry marketing experience strongly preferred

* Experience marketing General Contractors, Construction Management firms, Specialty Contractors, Developers, Architects, or 

   Engineers

* Google Ads

* LinkedIn Advertising

*
 Advertising

* Marketing Automation

* AI-assisted marketing

* Website migrations to WordPress

* Canva or Adobe Creative Suite



Who You Are



You are:



* Competitive

* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Results-driven

* Self-motivated

* Curious and continually learning

* Comfortable with accountability

* Passionate about producing exceptional work



You take ownership.



You finish what you start.



You believe details matter.



You don't settle for average.



Neither do we.



Required With Your Application



Please submit:



* Resume

* Portfolio

* Links to at least "three live websites" you personally worked on

* A description of your specific responsibilities and measurable results for each project

* Examples of SEO, traffic, ranking, or lead-generation improvements you helped achieve

* A summary of your construction, architecture, engineering, real estate, or professional-services marketing experience

* A list of the WordPress, WIX, CRM, analytics, SEO, AI, and marketing platforms you have used



Paid Skills Assessment



Selected finalists will complete a "paid real-world skills assessment" using one of our company websites.



We are interested in how you think, prioritize, communicate, solve problems, and execute—not simply what is written on your résumé.



Opportunity



This position offers the opportunity to grow into our "Director of Digital Marketing", leading the digital strategy for multiple construction companies.



Why Join Us



We are building companies designed to endure.



We invest in exceptional people, proven systems, advanced technology, AI, and disciplined execution.



We believe outstanding organizations are built by outstanding people.



If you are looking for "just another remote job," this position is probably not for you.



If you want to build a long-term career, make a meaningful impact, and help create one of the most respected construction organizations in the industry, we would like to meet you.



Please include the phrase "Built to Last" in the first sentence of your cover letter so we know you carefully read this posting.

title: SEO Blog Content VA (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
[SEO Blog Content VA | $9–14/hour depending on experience | Part-Time, Remote]



Job Overview

We are a direct-to-consumer eCommerce brand in the automotive accessories space. We are looking for a

detail-oriented VA to support our SEO blog content production.



We have a structured content system already in place. You do not need to come up with content ideas,

choose keywords, or make publishing decisions. Your job is to follow the system accurately, run the

brief, review the output carefully, resolve every flag, and submit clean work.



This is an execution and quality-control role. Attention to detail matters more than writing ability.



Responsibilities

• Receive a keyword assignment with a confirmed product page link

• Research secondary keywords and competitor URLs using Google

• Fill in the brief template and run it through our AI content system (Claude)

• Review the full output against a QA checklist before submitting

• Resolve every open flag in the output, or note clearly why it could not be resolved

• Submit organized work with metadata options labeled and open questions listed

• Target: 3-5 posts per week depending on post type



Requirements

• Comfortable using AI tools, specifically Claude, and following structured prompt systems

• Strong attention to detail: you read checklists fully and catch errors others miss

• Basic understanding of SEO concepts: meta titles, meta descriptions, internal linking, search intent

• Clear written English: you follow instructions exactly and flag ambiguity rather than guess

• Reliable turnaround: primary post type within 24 hours, longer posts within 48 hours

• Familiarity with Sanity CMS or similar platforms is a plus but not required



Hours: Part-time, as needed. Work will be assigned based on content needs, and weekly hours will vary.



Compensation

• Starting rate: $9–14/hour depending on experience

• Candidates who demonstrate clean output, fast turnaround, and low error rates will be considered for a rate increase after the first 30 days.



How to Apply

Please submit your application through the OnlineJobs.ph messaging system.

To confirm you have read this posting carefully, start your message with the word "COVERLAND-READY" on the first line. Applications that do not begin with this word will not be reviewed.

Your message must include:

• The word "COVERLAND-READY" as the first line

• A brief note on your background and why this role fits (3-5 sentences)

• One example of content QA, editorial, or checklist work you have done

• In one sentence, explain the difference between a meta title and a meta description

• Confirmation that you are comfortable using Claude or a comparable AI writing tool

• Your resume/CV



We will review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates about next steps, which will include a short skills test.



Thanks.

title: Bookkeeper / Admin Assistant (Hybrid)
description:
Position: Bookkeeper / Admin Support

Type: Part-time to start, potential for full-time

Rate: $6-10/hr depending on experience

About the Role:

We're looking for someone to manage the books for a few online businesses. This isn't just a numbers-in-boxes role. If you're the type who likes creating order out of scattered tasks and enjoys picking up admin work wherever it's needed, you'll do well here.



Who I'm looking for:

- Self-motivated: you can take ownership of the books and admin tasks without needing daily check-ins

- Detail-oriented and genuinely comfortable with numbers, reconciliations, and keeping things accurate

- A good learner comfortable picking up new tools, systems, or processes as the businesses grow

- Reliable communicator with good written English

- Stable internet connection and able to work independently

- Comfortable doing some "detective work": tracking down missing invoices, unclear transactions, or information that isn't handed to you directly



What you'll do:

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and light accounting tasks for the businesses (reconciliations, expense tracking, invoice/payment tracking)

- Provide timely, real-time financial reporting, not just historical monthly summaries, so numbers can be acted on quickly

- Prepare reports for submission to an industry benchmarking platform 

- Work with the AAHA Chart of Accounts (
/resources/chart-of-accounts)

- Do monthly financial reviews via Loom

- Pick up light admin tasks as they come up

- Possibly help build out systems/processes as the businesses grow



What we need from you, in priority order:

1. Proven bookkeeping experience: reconciliations, expense tracking, invoice/payment tracking, monthly reports/P&L

2. Financial analysis: ability to spot trends and flag them proactively, not just report historicals

3. Admin/EA experience is a plus

4. Strong attitude toward learning new tools, systems, or industry-specific standards (like AAHA)

5. Experience working with US-based businesses

6. Expert-level QuickBooks Online proficiency

Start your message with the word BALANCE so I know you read this all the way through. Tell me how you manage or keep track of payments and subscriptions. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description:
Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM)

Location: Remote (US hours)

About OpenCall 

OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager who can take ownership of our customer relationships and ensure our AI agents are delivering measurable, undeniable value to the medical and dental practices we serve.

About the role 



As a Customer Success Manager at OpenCall, you are the bridge between our multi-location healthcare customers and our engineering/prompt teams. You aren't just doing check-in calls and sending NPS surveys; you are actively managing onboardings, understanding the complexities of medical scheduling, and driving product adoption.

You will own the post-sales lifecycle. When a new clinic comes online, you will guide them through deployment, ensuring their intake forms, scheduling rules, and practice quirks are perfectly translated into our system. You will look for optimization and expansion opportunities, and work directly with our Agent Developers to push automation rates higher and drive up booking numbers.



Responsibilities

- Own the customer lifecycle: Manage the onboarding, adoption, and retention of our medical and dental group partners. You are their primary advocate and point of contact.

- Workflow translation: Work with practice administrators to understand their specific operational rules, edge cases, and EHR/PMS integrations, ensuring our deployment team configures an optimal agent.

- Data-driven optimization: Review real call data and metrics. If a specific objection-handling flow isn't working for a dental clinic in Ohio, you are the one who flags it, measures the drop-off in booking rates, and coordinates the fix.

- Drive retention and expansion: Prove the ROI of OpenCall every single month, enabling the customer to roll out additional locations. You will run monthly and quarterly reviews grounded in hard data: calls handled, hours saved, and appointments booked.

- Feedback loop: Act as the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams. You will help prioritize feature requests and flag drift or friction in live deployments before the customer even notices.



What we're looking for

- You've managed complex customers and onboardings before. You have 6+ years of experience as a CSM in a B2B SaaS or HealthTech company

- Analytical and empirical. You don't just ask customers how they feel; you look at the dashboard. You are comfortable diving into the data to justify your recommendations.

- Deep empathy mixed with operational rigor. You stay organized when multiple projects are in flight. You understand that in healthcare workflows, a bad deployment costs real money for real practices, and you know how to manage expectations carefully.

- Exceptional communication. You can seamlessly translate highly technical AI concepts to a non-technical front-office manager, and then turn around and translate front-office operational chaos into clear requirements for our engineering team.

- Problem-solving mindset. You are proactive. When a customer is struggling, you don't just log a ticket—you dig in, listen to the failed call recordings, and come to the table with a proposed solution.



Preferred Qualifications

- 6+ years of direct customer success experience

- 4+ years of experience in healthcare operations, SaaS, or contact center technology.

- 4+ years of experience with medical/dental scheduling software and workflows, and you've seen how messy a front desk can get.

- 4+ years of experience working alongside technical teams (engineers, product managers, or AI developers) to iterate on a highly technical product.

- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Hubspot or a similar CRM	

- Prior demonstrated experience and success working with US companies during US business hours.

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (Full or partial US hours overlap required)



About OpenCall 



OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.



We are looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist who can rigorously pressure-test our AI agents and ensure they consistently deliver a flawless, human-like conversational experience for the medical and dental practices we serve. 



About the role



As a Quality Assurance Specialist at OpenCall, you are the final line of defense ensuring our AI voice agents sound natural, respond accurately, and navigate complex conversations flawlessly. This is a highly impactful, non-engineering role focused entirely on conversational quality and product reliability.



You will rigorously test both our inbound and outbound phone agents, actively trying to break them by introducing edge cases, unexpected questions, and complex medical scheduling scenarios. You will ensure our AI can handle the unpredictable nature of real human conversations before deployments go live for our medical and dental practices.



Responsibilities



- Conversational Testing: Conduct extensive manual testing of inbound and outbound AI voice agents over the phone, simulating real-world patient interactions, objections, and edge cases.



- Issue Identification & Reporting: Document bugs, prompt failures, unnatural pauses, and conversational dead-ends. You will translate these conversational breakdowns into clear, actionable reports for our engineering and prompt development teams.



- Call Auditing & Grading: Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts from live and test environments to grade AI performance against our strict quality and safety standards.



- Collaborative Iteration: Work closely with Agent Developers and Customer Success Managers to understand customer-specific workflows (like complex dental scheduling rules) and verify that the AI adheres to those precise constraints.



What we're looking for

- Extensive QA or relevant experience: You have 5+ years of experience in quality assurance, conversational design testing, contact center operations, or a highly rigorous analytical role.



- Exceptional English fluency: Because you are evaluating the nuances of spoken English—including tone, register, phrasing, and regional accents—native-level or highly fluent English speaking and listening skills are an absolute requirement.



- Meticulous attention to detail: You notice the subtle difference between an AI sounding "helpful" versus "robotic," and you possess the focus required to run through dozens of conversational flows without letting small errors slip through the cracks.



- Tech-savvy problem solver: You do not need to be an engineer or write code, but you must be highly comfortable working alongside technical teams, navigating internal dashboards, and utilizing modern software tools to log your findings.



Preferred Qualifications

- Full overlap with US business hours (partial overlap is acceptable for the ideal candidate).

- Prior experience testing voice AI, chatbots, LLMs, or working in conversational AI.

- Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical/dental scheduling workflows, or terminology.

Can you take a problem you've never seen before and figure out how to solve it? That's the person we're looking for.



We manage a growing portfolio of long-term residential and commercial rental properties in Minnesota. We need a resourceful, organized operator to take ownership of day-to-day operations: someone who thinks a step ahead, closes the loop, and makes sure work moves from "reported" to "done" without being chased.



We care more about how you think than about your exact job history. Some of our best people have come from executive assistant, operations, and hospitality backgrounds, not just property management. If you're sharp, organized, and a fast learner, we'll teach you our systems. We are not looking for a simple task-doer; we want someone who can be given a problem, think through the steps needed to solve it, and come back with the resources and solutions to do so.



**Growth-Minded & Solutions-Focused:** We don't dwell on problems; we find solutions. We want people who are hungry to learn, grow, and improve our systems every day.



**Positive Energy:** Property management sometimes involves surprise challenges. Pipes burst, tenants stop paying. It is critical that we approach our work with a positive attitude. We value collaboration, open communication, and a "can-do" spirit.



**A Relationship, Not a Transaction:** We want a years-long partnership where you feel supported, trusted, and empowered to make decisions.



**Impact Over Activity:** We value outcomes. You won't be micromanaged; you will be given clear goals and the freedom to execute, along with the support to be able to succeed.



This role will be 40 hours per week, once fully trained. Your compensation will reflect your experience, initiative, growth, and contribution to the business's success.



**Schedule:** Starting schedule will be Sunday and Monday 9-5PM, Tuesday-Thursday 8AM-4PM US East Coast hours.



**What you'd own:**

The "Loop-Closer": When a task comes in, you manage the communication, the schedule, and the reporting in 
 and in daily report-outs to the team. Your job is to make sure work moves from "reported" to "fully completed" as efficiently as possible, and that everyone involved has what they need to do their jobs.



Tenant communication, coordinating repairs and vendors, lease renewals and lease compliance, rent tracking and follow-up on outstanding balances, coordinating with housing assistance agencies, preparing eviction documentation when needed, move-in and move-out procedures and inspections, and keeping everything moving in

You coordinate with our accountant to ensure any questions they have are answered so our books stay accurate. You support the build of new systems and initiatives, as well as handling invoices, expense tracking, owner statements, paying invoices, updating tenant ledgers, and working within our financial SOPs.



**Communication (20%):** Warm, calm, and professional with tenants, contractors, and owners. You respond promptly, warmly, and correctly to tenant maintenance requests and contractor messages. You know how to present yourself in a warm, calm, professional manner no matter the situation, including when a conversation is difficult.



You'll thrive here if you're proactive and detail-oriented, comfortable making decisions without being micromanaged, hungry to learn, and looking for a long-term partnership rather than a transaction.



**Must have:** reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and comfort working US hours.



**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:**



3+ Years working in a US-Based Business with operations responsibility.



**Fluency in English:** Confident in multi-person meetings, initiating phone calls, and in non-scripted situations in English.



**The "Loop-Closer" DNA:** You live by the 24-hour no-update rule. If a project is open, you provide an update before we have to ask.

You have a positive growth mindset.



**Strong communication skills:** you are a proactive communicator who doesn't wait to be asked for updates. You're eager to participate in ongoing discussions about improving communication protocols and systems, and receptive to feedback.

title: AI Video Editor - Short-Form Ads, UGC, Reels | Full-Time, $1-2k/mo
description:
We're a gay wellness and personal care brand, scaling fast on Meta. We're hiring ONE full-time AI-native video editor to own our short-form video ad creative.



THE JOB

Every day you deliver one ad "batch": 1 hold (the main 15-25s ad body) + 3 hooks (different 0-3s openers) cut to test against it. Vertical 9:16 for Reels / TikTok / Meta, captioned, with sound. If those terms are second nature to you, you're the kind of editor we want.



YOU ARE AI-NATIVE

You don't just cut existing clips - you GENERATE the footage: AI animation, AI b-roll, AI avatars / UGC-style talking heads, and AI voiceover. You build scenes and visuals from prompts, then assemble them into finished ads. You're fluent in the modern AI creative stack (some mix of Higgsfield / Runway / Kling / Veo / Sora / ElevenLabs / Arcads / HeyGen / Captions) and you edit in CapCut, Premiere, or DaVinci with sharp pacing, clean captions, and real sound design. You can turn a written brief into a finished, scroll-stopping ad without hand-holding.



MUST-HAVES

- Proven short-form ad / UGC editing experience (send your best work)

- Fast, reliable daily output - this is a real full-time load

- Strong English for written briefs and feedback

- 100% comfortable with the subject matter: we're a gay wellness and personal care brand, and our ads deal openly with gay intimacy, anal sex, and sexual wellness. It's a professional product in a large, real market - but if these themes aren't for you, no worries, please skip this one.



PAY

$1,000-$2,000/month depending on proven speed and quality. We start with a small paid test batch, then a short paid trial, then full-time.

 calls and tasks, marketing responses, and communication blasts to drive client engagement.

title: Tech Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 p/m + Bonuses (Up to $1,400/ p/m)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:



- Company
 Page:





[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Social Media & Community Manager
description:
About fatsecret



Headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, fatsecret is a leading digital health company helping millions of people around the world achieve their weight loss, nutrition, and wellness goals.

We're looking for a creative, social-first marketer to join our growing team and help inspire healthier lives through engaging content and community building.

This is a remote role based in Metro Manila or nearby provinces, with regular in-person team catch-ups.



About the Role



You'll own and grow fatsecret's social media presence across key platforms, creating content that educates, motivates, and engages our global audience.

Working closely with our Content Marketing Manager, you'll plan and publish content, manage community engagement, identify emerging trends, and help evolve our social strategy from a single international presence to a more localized, multi-language approach.

A key focus of this role will be expanding our video-first content strategy, particularly through YouTube Shorts and other short-form video formats that drive brand awareness and audience growth.



What You'll Do



Content Creation & Publishing

- Plan and manage monthly content calendars across Instagram,
, YouTube (Shorts and selected long-form content), and occasionally LinkedIn and X.

- Create platform-native short-form videos, static posts, carousels, stories, and community content.

- Turn nutrition, weight loss, and product insights into engaging and accessible social content.

- Stay on top of platform trends and recommend new content opportunities.



Community Management

- Monitor and respond to comments and direct messages.

- Foster positive community engagement and maintain brand voice across platforms.

- Escalate customer support issues to our Manila Customer Support team when required.



Growth & Localization

- Help expand fatsecret's social presence into localised, multi-market social profiles.

- Adapt existing content pillars for different markets, languages, and cultural contexts.

- Support audience growth initiatives through organic social strategies and video-first content.



Reporting & Insights

- Track content performance and community metrics.

- Deliver weekly performance snapshots and monthly insights reports.

- Identify opportunities to improve engagement, reach, and follower growth.



What We're Looking For



Required

- 2–4 years' experience managing social media for a consumer-facing brand, app, or digital business.

- Demonstrated experience creating short-form video content for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts.

- Strong copywriting and storytelling skills with excellent written English.

- Experience with community management, including handling comments, messages, and escalation workflows.

- Proficiency with tools such as Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio, Canva, Figma, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar content creation platforms.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with reliable high-speed internet and a suitable home office setup.



Highly Desirable

- Background in Nutrition, Dietetics, Pharmacy, Health Sciences, or a related field.

- Experience managing social channels across multiple regions or languages.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted content creation and video production tools.

- Experience working with mobile apps, health technology, or digital wellness brands.



Why Join fatsecret?

- Work-from-home arrangement within Metro Manila and surrounding provinces.

- Quarterly in-person tea
etups with our Manila-based content and customer support teams.

- Working hours aligned with Melbourne, Australia (9:00am–5:00pm AEST).

- Small, collaborative team with global reach and meaningful impact.

- Fun virtual events, game nights, and opportunities to connect with colleagues around the world.

- Complimentary access to the Premium fatsecret app.



How to Apply



- Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter that includes:

- Why fatsecret interests you.

- Links to 2–3 social media posts you've created (video preferred), along with a brief explanation of why you believe they performed well.



Applications that do not include both a resume and the requested responses above will not be considered.

title: Outbound Sales / Appointment Setter — Packaging & Freight (US Company, Long-Term)
description:
About us

We're SUPPLY POINTe, a US supplier based in Arizona. We sell packaging — pallets, stretch film, boxes, strapping, warehouse supplies — to manufacturers, warehouses, and distribution centers across the country. We've just launched a freight division, so we now also move our customers' shipments (LTL, full truckload, expedited).



That means every company you call has two reasons to talk to us: what they pack with and how they ship it. Most of them are overpaying on at least one.



I'm Bob, the owner. You'd work directly with me and my operations director. Small team, real voice, no call center.



What you'd do

Call US businesses from a list we give you, get past the front desk, and reach the person who buys packaging or books freight (warehouse, purchasing, operations, logistics, traffic, or plant manager). Then have a real conversation and qualify them — find out whether there's a genuine opportunity on the packaging side, the freight side, or both.



Qualification is the heart of this job. You're not just booking meetings — you're finding out what we'd actually be quoting.

On the packaging side, you're listening for: what products they use (pallets, film, boxes, strapping), how much and how often, who supplies them today, how purchasing decisions get made, and anything coming up that changes their volume.

On the freight side, you're listening for: what they ship and where (their lanes), how often, LTL or full truckload, roughly how heavy or how many pallets per shipment, who they use today (broker or carrier), and any pain — late deliveries, damage, or rates that keep climbing.



You capture all of that in the CRM and book a meeting for us when it's real. Good qualification notes are what makes the next call work — a great set of requirements is worth more to me than a rushed extra dial.



What you would NOT do

No pricing, no quotes, no rates, no contracts, no negotiating. Our team handles all commercial discussions. Your job is to open the door, ask good questions, and hand us a clear picture.



What we're looking for

• Excellent spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent — this is a phone job first

• Real outbound calling experience (appointment setting, SDR, telemarketing, or inside sales)

• Genuine curiosity. The best people in this role ask one more question than they need to

• You listen more than you talk, and you don't fold at the first "no"

• Solid written English — your CRM notes are a deliverable, not an afterthought

• Reliable internet, a backup connection, a quiet space, and a headset



Nice to have

B2B experience; freight, logistics, 3PL, or trucking background; HubSpot; or any history calling manufacturers, warehouses, or distribution centers. No freight experience required — we'll train you. If you can ask good questions, you can learn this.



Hours (flexible — please read)

Our customers are on Arizona time (we don't change for daylight saving). You do not have to work all 8 hours on a US schedule. I need a minimum of 4-6 hours overlapping Arizona business hours (8am–5pm) for live calling. The rest of your shift — follow-ups, CRM notes, planning tomorrow's list — you do on your own schedule.



What success looks like

Steady daily calling, honest and detailed CRM notes, and a handful of well-qualified opportunities each week. Quality over volume — I'd rather have 30 good conversations than 60 rushed ones. Activity-tracking software runs during paid hours, so you should be comfortable with that.



Compensation & growth

• $5–7/hr USD, based on experience

• Paid weekly or bi-weekly

• Paid training and a paid trial — you're paid for every hour you work, from day one

title: Customer Service Team Lead  (experience required)
description:
itsGLO is a residential cleaning company in Toronto, Canada. We clean homes, condos, and move-outs across the city. Our office runs on Toronto hours, which means this role is a night shift in the Philippines.



We are hiring one person to run client communication and daily scheduling. You will be the voice of the company. Almost every client who calls us will speak to you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Answer inbound calls from clients. Most are people asking for a price on a clean. You will ask what they need, quote them, and book them.

- Reply to texts and
s from clients during the shift.

- Adjust the daily schedule as things change. A cleaner calls in sick, a client moves a booking, a job runs long. You sort it out and tell the people affected.

- Handle the occasional upset client. These are rare, roughly once every two weeks, but they matter. You will ask questions, understand the problem, and give the client a clear turnaround time.

- Keep our system up to date so the next person knows what happened.



THE SHIFT



Monday to Friday, 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM Manila time.



This is a real night shift. It is not a "sometimes late" schedule. If you have not worked overnight before, this role will be difficult, and we would rather you not apply.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- At least 2 years of overnight or graveyard shift work. Non-negotiable.

- Contact centre, BPO, dispatch, or service coordination experience. You have spoken to customers on a headset for a living.

- Spoken English that a Canadian homeowner will understand easily and trust. This is the single most important requirement in the role.

- Organized. You can hold ten moving pieces in a day without dropping any.

- Comfortable closing. When a client says "let me think about it," you know that is a lost sale, and you know what to say next.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



General virtual assistants, data entry, or admin-only backgrounds. This is a client-facing phone job, not a back-office job.



WHAT WE OFFER



- PHP 45,000 to 65,000 per month, depending on experience.

- Long-term, full-time. We are hiring one person and we intend to keep them.

- Written SOPs and training. You will not be guessing at how to do the job.

- A small company where your work is visible and your judgment is trusted.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a message with all THREE of the following. Applications missing any of them will not be read.



1. Two sentences: how long have you worked a night shift, and where?



2. Include the words itsGLO PH somewhere in your message. This tells us you read the whole post.



3. A VOICE RECORDING (1 to 2 minutes). Record yourself introducing yourself, and job experience and then answering this, out loud, as if you were on the phone with a real client:



"A customer calls asking for a price on a deep clean. You give her the price. She says: 'Okay, let me think about it and I'll get back to you.' What do you say next?"



Answer it the way you actually would on a call (not reading off of ChatGPT). We are listening for your spoken English.



We reply to every applicant who follows these three steps.

title: YouTube Shorts Editor for Ranking/Top 5 Channel (Long-Term, Daily Videos)
description:

This is NOT a one-time gig. We run multiple YouTube channels and want someone who will grow with us. Consistent performers get raises and more responsibility.



What you will do (your daily workflow)



1. Receive from us: a script with the Top 5 list + a ready voice-over audio file (generated in ElevenLabs).

2. Find matching video footage for each item in the ranking — from TikTok, Instagram Reels, X, Reddit, YouTube, or stock sites (Pexels, Pixabay). No watermarks allowed.

3. Edit a 30–60 second vertical Short (9:16, 1080x1920):

 • Fast pacing — a cut or visual change every 2–3 seconds

 • Countdown number overlays (5... 4... 3...)

 • Zooms, arrows, highlights where the VO points something out

 • Background music + sound effects (whooshes, dings)

 • Strong hook in the first 1 second

4. Upload the finished video to Google Drive and update the status in our tracker (Airtable/Notion).



Output required: 1 video per day, 6 days per week (after a short onboarding period).



Requirements

 • Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, or Reels)

 • CapCut or Premiere Pro (After Effects is a plus)

 • Basic English (enough to understand the script and match footage to it)

 • Reliable internet and computer

 • You follow an SOP precisely and communicate proactively when blocked



How to Apply



?? Start your application with the word MANGO — applications without it will be ignored.



Then include:



1. Links to 3–5 short-form videos you edited (YouTube Shorts / TikTok / Reels links, NOT raw files). If possible, include at least one ranking/countdown-style video.

2. Which editing software you use.

3. Your expected monthly salary and available hours per day.

4. One sentence: how would you find footage for "Top 5 Weirdest Animals in the Ocean"?



Hiring Process



We shortlist based on portfolios.

Paid test task ($15): we send you a script + voice-over, you deliver 1 finished Short within 48 hours.

Best test wins the position. Payment via Wise.



We reply within 3 days if shortlisted.

title: Full-Time Cinematic Documentary Video Editor & Assistant Story Producer
description:
Remote — Philippines

Long-term, full-time creative position

Starting compensation: $1,250 USD per month

Paid editing test for selected finalists



Can you find a compelling story inside ordinary real-life footage?



Whimsy Monstrum is a new creator-led documentary series about practical creatures, sculpting, fabrication, creature artists, conventions, fandom, creative experiments, and the construction of a large two-story creature workshop in Texas.



The purpose of the series is to share wonder, craftsmanship, humor, interesting people, creative failures, discoveries, and meaningful stories from real life.



I am looking for a full-time Documentary Video Editor & Assistant Story Producer who can do more than make footage look polished. I need someone who can review unscripted material and recognize:



What the episode is really about

What the central question is

What the creator is trying to accomplish

Why the goal matters

What creates uncertainty, resistance, or difficulty

Where the story changes

What footage or explanation is missing

How to build an ending that feels earned



This is a creative storytelling role—not a general video editing position.



The films should feel cinematic, playful, curious, visually rich, funny, emotionally honest, and human. The goal is to build an original Whimsy Monstrum style together—not imitate another filmmaker or YouTube channel.



What You Will Be Editing



Footage may include:



Practical creature design and fabrication

Sculpting, molding, painting, mechanics, and special-effects processes

Construction of a large creature workshop

Creative challenges and experiments

Creature artists and collaborators

Conventions, fandom, and live events

Interviews and conversations

Drone footage

Action-camera footage

Construction time-lapse

Sony mirrorless-camera footage

Wireless microphone recordings

Personal reflections and voice-over

Natural workshop sound

Random Camping Trips

Conventions /  Creayure Workshops

Professional Interviews and more



Some episodes will follow a concrete mission or experiment. Others may explore an artist, an idea, a practical-effects technique, a convention experience, or why creatures and physical craftsmanship matter.



Initial Weekly Publishing Schedule



After onboarding and development of the production system, the Core Cadence will be:



Monday — Monstrum Field Note (small fun video) Approximately 1–3 minutes

One interesting discovery, technique, object, failure, idea, or 
nt

Usually created from footage already reviewed for a flagship episode

Amazing Music - beautiful Luts and composition - great B-roll and splice supporting edit



Tuesday — Flagship Film A

Approximately 6–10 minutes initially (The durations will get longer over time - Goal 20 to 25 miute videos)

Cinematic, story-led nonfiction

Clear opening, development, uncertainty or obstacle, reveal, and ending

Amazing Music - beautiful Luts and composition - great B-roll and splice supporting edits



Friday — Flagship Film B

Approximately 6–10 minutes initially (The durations will get longer over time - Goal 20 to 25 miute videos)

A separate complete story with the same quality standards

Amazing Music - beautiful Luts and composition - great B-roll and splice supporting edit



A shorter Thursday process story or reveal may occasionally be produced during the initial period when the footage and schedule allow. It will not immediately replace the Core Cadence.



The long-term goal is to develop selected flagship stories toward 15–25 minutes, but videos should never be padded merely to reach a target duration. The strongest version of the story determines the length.



Future Expansion



After the Core Cadence is functioning reliably, the publishing schedule will gradually expand to include:



Another video idea or edited interview or conversation video to be introduced for the week.

A short process story, experiment, or reveal

Longer 15–25-minute flagship documentaries when the subject supports them



The interview format will generally require clean dialogue editing, removal of repetition and dead space, limited B-roll, basic multicamera work, sound treatment, and restrained graphics.



The short process/reveal format will normally be built from footage already reviewed and should tell one focused, complete mini-story.



Expansion will happen gradually after a repeatable editorial system has been established.



Footage and Story Materials



Each flagship will normally include approximately 2–5 hours (estimated) of relevant source footage.



Most episodes will also include:



A written episode packet

A basic chronology of events

The goal or central question

Why the story matters

Important obstacles or uncertainty

Must-use 
nts

Material that must not be used

A possible opening and ending

A personal voice memo explaining what happened internally

Notes about missing context

Available drone, time-lapse, action-camera, and detail footage



The editor will not be expected to blindly search through unlimited, unexplained footage.



Flagship footage should normally be delivered approximately 4–6 days before publication, allowing time for story mapping, editing, feedback, revision, export, and quality control.



Five-hour footage packages may occur, but most packages should remain closer to two or three relevant hours.



Your Responsibilities



You will:



Review and understand unscripted footage

Organize footage, audio, proxies, and project files

Identify the central question and narrative spine

Create a short story map before fully polishing the edit

Build selects, assemblies, rough cuts, fine cuts, and final masters

Construct scenes using dialogue, actions, reactions, details, and natural sound

Preserve chronology and factual context

Identify missing reactions, narration, interviews, or pickup footage

Recommend additional shots while they can still be filmed

Build engaging openings that honestly match the story

Create satisfying progression rather than only attractive montages

Develop earned reveals and endings

Perform basic color correction and camera matching

Clean and balance dialogue

Use natural sound, room tone, sound effects, music, and silence thoughtfully

Add motivated transitions that support changes in time, place, action, or meaning

Create and maintain recurring titles, lower thirds, graphics, audio presets, and export templates

Deliver complete editable project files

Deliver final masters, review files, and caption files

Maintain an accurate music and sound-effects cue sheet

Help the creator improve how future stories are filmed



You should be comfortable respectfully saying:



“The footage does not support the story we originally planned, but I see a stronger story here.”



That kind of editorial judgment is valuable.



Story Expectations



Every flagship should attempt to contain:



A clear question, mission, desire, or curiosity

A reason the audience should care

A beginning state

Real uncertainty, resistance, discovery, or difficulty

Decisions and reactions

Visible progression

A reveal, result, or meaningful outcome

A changed understanding or closing realization



Drama should never be manufactured. Real limitations, mistakes, disagreement, discovery, difficult choices, and changing direction are enough.



The story should create engagement—not constant visual noise.



Editing Style



The work should feel:



Cinematic without feeling artificial

Entertaining without becoming exaggerated

Polished while remaining human

Curious, playful, warm, and occasionally emotional

Interested in physical texture, tools, materials, hands, faces, and creature details

Comfortable allowing reactions or quiet 
nts to breathe

Honest about failures and uncertainty

Driven by character, curiosity, decisions, and change



This is not an effects-first, 
-heavy, constant-caption role.



Fast editing may be appropriate during movement, explanation, comedy, or process. Slower pacing may be appropriate when a reaction, decision, or emotional 
nt deserves space.



Good judgment matters more than applying the same pace to every scene.



Sound Design and Music



Strong audio judgment is essential.



You should be able to:



Make dialogue consistently clear and understandable

Apply conservative noise reduction

Balance dialogue, music, natural sound, and effects

Use workshop ambience and room tone to make scenes feel physical

Build natural-sound bridges between shots

Add sound effects that support real actions without becoming distracting

Let silence or natural sound carry a scene when music is unnecessary

Use music to support story changes rather than cover the entire timeline

Mix music properly beneath dialogue

Avoid generic or excessively dramatic trailer treatment

Check final audio on headphones, ordinary speakers, and phone speakers



Whimsy Monstrum will maintain a company-owned Epidemic Sound or equivalent commercial music account.



Only approved, properly licensed music and sound effects may be used. Every project must include a list of music and sound-effect assets.



Transitions and Visual Effects



Transitions should help the viewer understand changes in:



Time

Location

Action

Scale

Mood

Meaning



Useful approaches may include:



Match cuts

Movement-based cuts

Sound bridges

Time-lapse transitions

Environmental transitions

Visual callbacks

Carefully selected speed changes

Motivated graphic transitions



Template transitions should not be added merely to make the edit appear more complicated.



No generative footage, synthetic performance, voice cloning, face alteration, or major visual manipulation may be used without written approval.



Deliverables



Normal project deliverables will include:



Story map

Rough-cut review file

Revised cut

Final 4K master

1080p review or platform version

Caption file

Editable Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve project

Organized project folders

Graphics and title assets

Music and sound-effects cue sheet

Clean export without captions when requested

Final quality-control review



The editor should use proxy workflows when necessary to manage large 4K files efficiently.



Compensation and Benefits

Starting Package

$1,250 USD monthly base compensation

$50 USD monthly internet/software allowance

10 paid personal days annually

Annual bonus equal to one month of base compensation, prorated for partial years

Fully paid initial 30-day engagement

Formal performance and workflow review after 60 days

Long-term growth potential

Performance Increase



After three consecutive months of reliably maintaining the Core Cadence—two weekly flagships and one weekly Field Note—while meeting the agreed standards for quality, deadlines, communication, licensing, project organization, and revisions, the role will move into its Expansion Phase.



When the editor begins reliably handling the expanded schedule, including the additional interview and short process/reveal formats, base compensation will increase to:



$1,400 USD per month



The additional formats will be introduced gradually and will normally be lower-complexity productions.



When 15–25-minute flagships become the regular standard, rather than occasional special episodes, workload, staffing, source-footage volume, and compensation will be reviewed separately.



What “Reliable Performance” Means



Success will be evaluated using clear standards:



Two accepted flagships and one accepted Field Note delivered weekly

At least 90% of releases delivered by the agreed deadline

Clear story structure and understandable progression

Correct chronology and context

Properly licensed music and sound effects

Organized project-file delivery

Timely communication

Useful pickup-shot and narration recommendations

An average of one consolidated revision round or fewer

No repeated preventable technical errors

A sustainable workflow that does not require constant emergency overtime



Quality and communication matter as much as speed.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time remote role of approximately 40 hours per week.



The normal work schedule may be flexible. A full U.S. overnight shift is not required.



The editor must be available for:



A regular weekly story-development meeting

Scheduled creative discussions

Limited overlap with U.S. Central Time

Timely communication when footage, information, or deadlines are at risk



You should have dependable internet access and a reasonable backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



Applicants should not have another full-time commitment that conflicts with this role.



Preferred Experience



Strong candidates may have experience with:



Short documentaries

Observational or vérité filmmaking

Wedding films with real narrative construction

Artist or craft profiles

Character-driven nonfiction

Personal essay films

Human-interest branded documentaries

Interviews and multicamera productions

Independent films

Long-form YouTube storytelling

Film or television post-production

Cinematic process videos



You do not need to have worked on a large YouTube channel.



The ability to find and shape a real story matters more than platform-specific tricks.



Required Qualifications



You should have:



Strong spoken and written English

Excellent understanding of narrative structure

Strong comprehension of tone, humor, subtext, and emotional context

Experience editing real people and unscripted footage

Professional proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

Strong file-management habits

Good audio judgment

Basic color-correction and camera-matching ability

A computer capable of handling long-form projects through a proxy workflow

Dependable storage and backup practices

Reliable internet access

The ability to receive direct creative feedback professionally

The confidence to offer your own editorial point of view

The ability to meet recurring weekly deadlines

Ownership, Confidentiality, and AI



All supplied materials and commissioned work are confidential.



This includes:



Camera footage

Audio

Proxies

Transcripts

Story documents

Voice memos

Project files

Timelines

Graphics

Rough cuts

Final masters

Unreleased ideas



All commissioned project files and outputs will remain the property of Whimsy Monstrum under the final written agreement.



Project materials may not be:



Published without permission

Shared with another editor or subcontractor without permission

Used in a portfolio without written approval

Submitted to unapproved cloud services

Used for AI training

Used to create synthetic voices, faces, footage, or performances

Retained after the required project-delivery and deletion period



Approved AI tools may be used for limited purposes such as:



Transcription

Synchronization

Footage logging

Captioning

Conservative audio cleanup



Any AI or cloud service used with project material must be disclosed and approved.



Paid Editing Test



Selected finalists will receive the same controlled, paid editing exercise.



Test Terms

Approximately 45–75 minutes of organized footage

A 90-second to 3-minute finished story edit

Maximum of approximately six working hours

$150 USD paid to each finalist who completes the agreed test

No unpaid test work

Test footage will not be commercially published without a separate agreement



The test will evaluate:



Ability to identify the underlying story

Beginning, development, and ending

Preservation of natural personality

Pacing and emotional judgment

Music and natural-sound choices

Pickup recommendations

Technical organization

Ability to understand and respond to feedback



The top candidates may receive the same paid revision notes as an additional final step.



How to Apply



Use this subject line:



PRACTICAL MAGIC — [Your Name]



At the beginning of your application, answer this question in no more than three sentences:



What turns a process video into a story?



Then include:



Two or three complete story-led films. Do not send only a showreel.

Your exact role on each film.

One example of a story you discovered in footage that differed from the original plan.

One example of a beautiful shot or scene you removed because it weakened the story.

A brief explanation of how you would turn three hours of unscripted workshop footage into an engaging eight-minute film.

Your preferred editing software.

Your computer specifications.

Your internet upload and download speed.

Your backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

Your current availability and other ongoing work commitments.

Your requested monthly compensation.

One previous client reference.

A short video introduction explaining why this role interests you.



No formal cover letter is required. Thoughtful, direct answers are preferred.



Applications that include only a showreel, ignore the questions, or do not use the requested subject line may not be reviewed.

Accuracy is the most important part of this role. Many of our products include technical details, model numbers, approvals, certifications, specifications, manuals, and safety-related information. Product pages must be built carefully and reviewed for accuracy before publishing.



The primary responsibility will be to update existing product pages and creating new Shopify product pages by using supplier/manufacturer information, provided images, product documents, and our existing website format.



Responsibilities:

- Create collections for new products

- Upload product images, documents, PDFs, manuals, spec sheets, and other supporting files

- Add accurate product tags, collections, product types, and vendor information

- Write clear, SEO-friendly product titles, descriptions, meta descriptions, and URL handles

- Use AI tools to help improve readability, structure, and SEO while verifying all technical information against the source material

- Use Canva or similar tools to create simple, clean product graphics when needed

- Add image alt text and organize images in a consistent, professional format

- Follow our product page template and brand style closely

- Review all product pages for accuracy, consistency, grammar, formatting, and missing information before publishing

- Flag unclear or conflicting product information before adding it to the website



Required Skills:

- 2+ years of Shopify product listing or ecommerce product management experience

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Experience building or editing Shopify product pages

- Ability to work with technical product information, SKUs, specifications, and supplier data

- Basic understanding of ecommerce SEO, including product titles, keywords, meta descriptions, URL structure, and image alt text

- Comfortable using AI tools responsibly to improve product content without inventing or assuming product details

Preferred Experience:
