title: Social Media Buzz Creator / Content Strategist — Full-Time, 100% Remote
description:
FormÉduc is Hiring a Social Media Buzz Creator / Content Strategist



Full-Time, 100% Remote



Employment type: Full-time, long-term remote position, with continued collaboration based on performance.



Location: 100% remote - open to candidates based in the Philippines



Hours: 35-40 hours per week



Schedule: Flexible, with some availability for meetings and collaboration during Quebec business hours



Salary: To be discussed



Language requirement: Excellent written French is essential



Brands: FormÉduc and its various projects across Quebec, Canada



YOU ARE NOT JUST LOOKING FOR A JOB.



You are looking for a creative playground.



At FormÉduc, we are not simply looking for someone to manage social media.



We are looking for someone who is passionate about ideas.



Almost a character.



Someone bold, imaginative, memorable, confident, and a little unconventional.



Someone who believes in their ideas, enjoys surprising people, and is not afraid to propose something different.



Someone who sees an advertisement and immediately thinks about how to make it better.



Someone who spots trends before they become popular.



Someone who knows how to create content that makes people stop scrolling.



Someone who naturally analyzes why an advertisement works or why it does not.



If this sounds like you, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will become a creative force behind several brands:



* FormÉduc

* Vol 101

* Famille d'accueil 

* La Boutique FormÉduc

* FormÉduc Conseil

* Several new projects to come



Your role will not simply be to publish content.



You will:



* Develop original concepts for social media.

* Create campaign ideas that capture attention.

* Propose videos, advertisements, posts, and content series.

* Find creative ways to generate interest and conversation around our projects.

* Identify relevant trends for our different brands.

* Develop concepts, scripts, and storyboards for video production in collaboration with the team in Quebec.

* Turn simple ideas into memorable content.

* Regularly bring forward new ideas without waiting for detailed instructions.

* Understand how social media platforms distribute and recommend content.

* Test different creative approaches and improve ideas based on results.



We are looking for someone proactive, confident, independent, and full of ideas.



Someone who can think, propose, test, improve, and move projects forward without constant supervision.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be the right person if most of these statements describe you:



* You are passionate about marketing and content creation.

* You enjoy watching and analyzing advertisements.

* You follow trends on TikTok,
, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other platforms.

* You understand how to create content suited to each platform.

* You are creative, curious, independent, and proactive.

* You naturally come up with new ideas.

* You have a strong, distinctive, and memorable creative personality.

* You are not afraid to suggest something surprising or unexpected.

* You know how to be original while respecting the goals and identity of a brand.

* You can transform an idea into a clear, realistic, and engaging concept.

* You want to create campaigns people will remember.

* You can produce excellent written French and pay close attention to detail.



You may use AI tools to support your French writing.



However, the final result must sound natural, polished, carefully reviewed, and fully adapted to the brand's tone.



We will evaluate your ability to recognize generic AI-generated content and transform it into strong, human, high-quality communication.



Experience is important, but your creativity, personality, strategic thinking, and the quality of your ideas matter even more.



We would rather work with a passionate person who brings bold ideas and a strong creative personality than someone who simply has several years of experience.



THE APPLICATION CHALLENGE



If your application looks like every other application, it may go unnoticed.



Show us how you think.



You may submit:



* A video

* An advertisement

* A campaign idea

* A presentation

* A concept

* A social media post

* A short marketing strategy

* Any other creative format that could make us say:



"Wow... this person thinks differently."



YOUR CHALLENGE



Imagine you have a $500 marketing budget to make people across Quebec talk about FormÉduc.



What would you do?



Present your idea, explain your strategy, and show us how you would use the budget.



There is no single correct answer.



We want to discover your creativity, logic, strategic thinking, and way of approaching a challenge.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply directly using the "Apply" button on OnlineJobs.ph.



Also send your application by
 to:







CC:







Use this exact subject line:



Application - FormÉduc Buzz Creator - First Name and Last Name



Your application must include:



1. Your response to the $500 challenge, submitted as text, a video, a presentation, or another creative format.



2. A link to your portfolio or relevant examples of social media content, advertisements, campaigns, videos, or projects you have worked on.



3. A short introduction about yourself, written in French.



4. A brief explanation of why this role interests you.



At FormÉduc, words matter.



Your French, creativity, tone, attention to detail, and the way you communicate will all be part of our evaluation.



We are not looking for 100 applications.



We are looking for three or four truly creative, original, independent people who can make a real difference.



If you are already thinking of several ideas while reading this, we look forward to seeing what you can create.

* Understand internet jokes, memes, popular videos, and online culture

* Notice new trends while you are scrolling



This is a real paid opportunity. I plan to hire at least 5 people.



Your job is simple: scroll through social media like you normally do and send me any new trends, popular videos, sounds, jokes, products, or topics you notice.



I am building a platform that finds and tracks new internet trends. I need people who are already active on social media to help me spot them early.



You do not need to spend extra hours working. You can do this while you are in your bed scrolling.



You can earn an extra **$20 to $50 USD per month** for doing something you already do every day.

Hello!



Naghahanap ako ng mga taong maraming oras na ginugugol sa pag-scroll sa Instagram, TikTok, at iba pang social media apps.



Kailangan ay:



* Gumagamit ka ng social media nang hindi bababa sa 2 oras bawat araw

Simple lang ang gagawin mo: mag-scroll ka sa social media tulad ng normal mong ginagawa at ipadala sa akin ang anumang bagong trend, sikat na video, tunog, joke, produkto, o paksa na mapapansin mo.



Gumagawa ako ng isang platform na naghahanap at sumusubaybay sa mga bagong internet trend. Kailangan ko ng mga taong aktibo na sa social media para makatulong na makita agad ang mga bagong uso.



Hindi mo kailangang maglaan ng dagdag na oras. Maaari mo itong gawin habang normal kang nag-i-scroll.



Maaari kang kumita ng dagdag na **$20 hanggang $50 USD bawat buwan** sa paggawa ng bagay na ginagawa mo na araw-araw.

title: Solar Electrical Engineer
description:
About NRG

NRG is a premier solar installation company based in California. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality, code-compliant, and cutting-edge residential and commercial solar and Energy Storage System (ESS) solutions. As we continue to scale our operations, we are seeking a highly meticulous Electrical Engineer to join our international team remotely to lead our design solutions, provide drafting direction, and oversee quality control.



Position Overview

In this role, you will wear two hats: acting as our elite problem-solver for complex solar layouts and serving as our final line of defense for quality control. You won't just review plans; you will actively engineer solutions for our most challenging projects and direct our drafting team on how to execute them flawlessly.

Your focus will primarily be on residential solar + storage systems, with occasional commercial project engineering.



Key Responsibilities

Complex Solution Engineering: Take the lead on complex, custom, or non-standard residential and commercial projects. Analyze site constraints and engineer the absolute best electrical and structural solutions for optimal system performance.

Drafter Direction & Mentorship: Create clear design layouts and provide explicit instructions, markups, and guidance to our drafting team on exactly how to assemble and structure the final plansets.

Plan Review & Quality Control: Perform rigorous QC checks on completed electrical and structural plansets to ensure they are flawless before submission.

Technical Auditing: Verify single-line diagrams (SLDs), three-line diagrams, conduit/wire sizing, string sizing, voltage drop calculations, and main panel breaker ratings.

Code Compliance: Ensure all designs align seamlessly with the National Electrical Code (NEC), California Electrical Code, and local AHJ (Authority Having Jurisdiction) / Utility guidelines.



Qualifications & Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering is required.

US Solar Experience: Minimum of 2–3+ years of direct experience designing or reviewing US-based solar PV and ESS (battery backup) projects.

Codes Knowledge: Deep operational familiarity with the National Electrical Code (NEC) and California utility/AHJ interconnect standards.

Project Profile: Proven track record handling complex residential designs. Experience with commercial solar systems is a significant plus.

Software Expertise: Strong proficiency in AutoCAD or similar solar design/drafting software. Direct experience using Aurora Solar is a major advantage.

Leadership Skills: Ability to clearly direct, communicate, and hand off design concepts to drafting teams.

Work Setup: Reliable, high-speed internet connection, a capable engineering-grade workstation, and a professional, quiet remote working environment.

Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.



What We Offer

Competitive Remote Pay: $5-$15 USD per hour, scaled based on your depth of experience and technical expertise.

100% Remote Flexibility: Work from the comfort of your home in the Philippines or Armenia.

Stable Pipeline: Consistent, reliable workflow from a well-established, growing California installer.

Professional Growth: Opportunity to take ownership of complex engineering challenges and lead design direction alongside an elite international team.

title: Virtual Assistant — Laundromat Owner Research, Cold Calling & Off-Market Acquisition Prospecting
description:
Virtual Assistant — Laundromat Owner Research, Cold Calling & Off-Market Acquisition Prospecting



I am a serious buyer actively seeking to acquire existing laundromats in the Phoenix, Arizona metropolitan area. I am looking for an exceptional virtual assistant to help identify laundromat owners, research ownership history, verify contact information, make respectful outbound calls to owners, identify those potentially open to selling, and schedule qualified conversations with me.



This is not a high-pressure telemarketing position. The objective is to have professional, respectful conversations directly with business owners and identify those who may be willing to discuss selling their laundromat now or in the future.



Responsibilities



You will:



* Identify every reasonably discoverable laundromat throughout the Phoenix metropolitan area.

* Research the legal business entity associated with each location.

* Identify the actual owner, principal, or other decision-maker.

* Research how long the current owner has owned the laundromat, with particular emphasis on owners with 15 or more years of ownership.

* Research whether the laundromat owner also owns the underlying real estate.

* Use public records, business databases, Google Maps, company websites and other approved sources.

* Verify business phone numbers, publicly available contact information and ownership details.

* Enter all research into a structured CRM or spreadsheet.

* Clearly identify the source supporting important data points.

* Make live outbound calls to laundromat owners during appropriate Arizona business hours.

* Professionally ask whether the owner would be open to discussing a possible sale to a serious buyer.

* Ask appropriate follow-up questions when an owner expresses interest.

* Maintain detailed notes on every conversation.

* Schedule qualified owner conversations directly with me.

* Conduct professional follow-up when appropriate.

* Immediately honor any request not to be contacted again.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate has:



* Excellent spoken and written English.

* A clear, professional and natural telephone voice.

* Previous cold-calling experience.

* Experience speaking with business owners.

* Strong internet and public-record research skills.

* Experience in real estate, business acquisitions, skip tracing, lead generation or off-market prospecting.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong judgment and discretion.

* Experience with spreadsheets and CRM systems.

* The ability to follow a process without sounding robotic.

* Availability during Phoenix, Arizona business hours for outbound calling.



Important



This role requires both strong research ability and strong telephone communication. Applicants must be comfortable performing both.



Quality is more important than making the greatest possible number of calls. The objective is to correctly identify owners, create positive conversations and identify genuine acquisition opportunities.



To Apply



Please provide:



1. A brief description of your cold-calling experience.

2. A brief description of your research or lead-generation experience.

3. Any experience speaking directly with small-business owners.

4. Any real-estate acquisition, skip-tracing or public-record research experience.

5. Your hourly rate.

6. Your availability during Phoenix, Arizona business hours.

7. A short voice recording introducing yourself as though you were calling a laundromat owner on behalf of a serious buyer.

8. The tools and CRM systems you have previously used.



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial assignment.

title: Experienced Sales and Lead Generation Specialist (Remote)
description:
Job Overview: 



As a Sales and Lead Generation Specialist, you will be responsible for identifying, qualifying, and generating leads for our sales team and consultants. Working remotely with US-based consultants, your primary goal will be to build a strong sales pipeline through strategic prospecting, outreach, and relationship management. You will leverage a variety of digital tools, platforms, and outreach methods to ensure that our consultants have a steady stream of qualified leads, helping drive business growth and increase revenue. 



 



Key Responsibilities: 



Lead Generation & Prospecting: 



Conduct research to identify potential leads and new business opportunities within targeted industries or geographic areas. 



Use a variety of methods to source and qualify leads, including cold calling,
 outreach, social media, and networking platforms like LinkedIn. 



Utilize lead generation tools (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo) to identify decision-makers, gather contact details, and build targeted lists. 



Generate a high volume of qualified leads for consultants to convert into clients, maintaining an organized and up-to-date database of prospects. 



Sales Outreach & Nurturing: 



Initiate outbound communication with potential clients through
, phone calls, and social media platforms to introduce the company’s services. 



Personalize outreach strategies based on research and insights, tailoring messaging to resonate with each prospect’s business needs. 



Nurture relationships with leads by following up regularly, answering inquiries, and providing additional information about services and solutions. 



Qualify leads by assessing their business needs, timeline, and budget to ensure alignment with the company's offerings. 



Collaboration with Sales & Consultant Team: 



Work closely with the US consultants to understand their sales needs, target markets, and key value propositions. 



Share qualified leads and insights with consultants, ensuring they are equipped with all necessary information to close sales. 



Coordinate with the sales team to ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads, assisting in preparing proposals, quotes, and presentations when needed. 



CRM & Data Management: 



Use CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) to track lead generation efforts, manage prospects, and update lead status. 



Document lead interactions, monitor sales activities, and provide weekly reports on progress, conversion rates, and pipeline status. 



Analyze CRM data to identify trends, track KPIs, and improve lead generation strategies over time. 



Market Research & Industry Insights: 



Stay up to date on industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities to ensure outreach strategies are relevant and targeted. 



Conduct research to understand the needs and pain points of potential clients, adjusting messaging and outreach tactics accordingly. 



Sales Support & Ad-Hoc Projects: 



Assist in the creation of sales collateral (e.g., presentations, case studies,
 templates) to support outreach and lead conversion efforts. 



Participate in ad-hoc sales and marketing initiatives, including campaigns, webinars, or client events as needed. 



Provide feedback on lead generation strategies, suggest improvements, and implement new ideas to optimize lead conversion rates. 



Take on special projects or initiatives as required by the team or management to support overall business goals.  



Perform other duties and tasks as needed to ensure the smooth operations of the department and company.  



Adapt to and take on additional tasks and projects as. It is necessary to support and grow various aspects of the company.

Respond to this job post and the public link to your CV.

title: US Accountant / Bookkeeper — Xero, Gusto Payroll & Multi-Entity (Controller-Level)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

=====================================================================

We're hiring a genuinely capable, controller-level operator to run the books and compliance for a small group of related US companies — a few hours a week, done right. This is NOT a junior bookkeeping seat. The volume is low, but the scope is broad and the standard is high: multi-entity bookkeeping, US multi-state compliance filings, payroll operations, cash forecasting, and light financial modeling.



TYPE OF WORK:

Part-time (~5 hrs/week to start) — strong path to full-time based on performance (heavier around payroll, month-end close, and filing deadlines). Must have meaningful daily overlap with US business hours to turn around approvals and coordinate.



SALARY:

$10–$15/hour, depending on experience



You'll work directly with the owner, who approves all payments and material decisions. We care about one thing above all: quality. If you're the right operator, this part-time engagement has a clear path to full-time as we grow.



You'll manage four sets of books:

- Three state-specific neurology practices structured as physician-owned professional corporations (PCs), operating across California and New York

- A management services organization (MSO) that handles all non-clinical support, employs non-clinical staff, and charges each practice a service fee

- A separate Washington-based software consultancy (B&O and sales/use tax exposure)



The three healthcare entities are highly interrelated, with recurring intercompany activity (MSO service fees flowing from the PCs, MSO paying shared costs). Comfort with MSO / friendly-PC ("management company + professional corporation") structures and intercompany accounting is a major plus.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

=====================================================================

1. BOOKKEEPING — All 4 entities in Xero. Ongoing categorization, reconciliations, and clean intercompany entries between the MSO and the PCs. Keep the books accurate and close-ready.



2. PAYROLL OPERATIONS — Gusto. Own the operational side: enter hourly employee data, add reimbursements, ensure every run is queued and paid on time. Reconcile Gusto-paid taxes and flag/resolve discrepancies.



3. CASH MANAGEMENT & PAYMENT QUEUE — Queue bills and payments (with backup) for owner review and approval. Monitor cashflow health and help sequence/time cash to keep sufficient funds on hand.



4. FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS —

   - Maintain a rolling ~13-week cash forecast to support cash-timing decisions and flag risks early.

   - Help build and maintain driver-based projections across the entities. An existing model is started; you'll collect operational drivers/inputs and help turn it into real, maintained projections.



5. US COMPLIANCE FILINGS (multi-state calendar) — Own the filing calendar and handle:

   - CA franchise tax, Statement of Information, annual reports

   - NY / NYC quarterly payments and filings

   - WA B&O tax

   - DE annual/quarterly filings as needed

   - Sales/use tax returns (MSO and/or consultancy)

   - Quarterly estimated income tax payments

   - 1099-NEC issuance to contractors



6. ACCOUNTANT PREP — Prepare and hand off clean, organized books to our external CPAs for tax prep. Be the day-to-day point of contact for their questions.



MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS (HARD FILTERS — do not apply without these)

=====================================================================

- Xero fluency, including multi-entity setups and intercompany transactions. Real Xero experience — NOT "I know QuickBooks and can learn it."

- US multi-state business tax & compliance literacy — able to INDEPENDENTLY handle filings across CA, NY/NYC, WA, and DE. Non-negotiable regardless of where you're based.

- Gusto payroll operations — running the operational side, entering data, reconciling payroll taxes.

- Cash forecasting + basic financial modeling — can build/maintain a 13-week forecast and work in a driver-based projection model.

- Multi-entity / intercompany bookkeeping experience.

- Reliability and timeliness — payments and filings hit deadlines every time; proactive about flagging issues.

- Strong written English and enough US-hours overlap to coordinate approvals.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

=====================================================================

- Healthcare MSO / friendly-PC / DSO or medical-group accounting experience (understands the management-fee + professional-corporation structure).

- Experience preparing books for external CPAs at close/year-end.

- CPA, CMA, or equivalent credential (or clearly equivalent hands-on depth).

- Experience serving multiple small clients as a fractional resource.



HOW TO APPLY  (applications that skip these steps will be ignored)

=====================================================================

Start your application with the word "XERO-CTRL" so we know you read this in full. Then answer these directly and briefly:



1. Walk me through your hands-on Xero experience — specifically multiple entities and intercompany transactions.

2. Which US state filings have you PERSONALLY handled? Have you dealt with CA franchise tax/SOI, NY/NYC, WA B&O, or DE filings?

3. Have you worked with an MSO / professional-corporation (medical group) structure or similar management-company arrangement? Describe the intercompany flows you managed.

4. Describe a cash forecast you've built and maintained. How did you handle a cash-timing crunch?

5. How do you operate as a fractional/part-time resource across several clients — how do you keep deadlines from slipping?

6. What's your experience running Gusto operationally and reconciling payroll taxes?



We will not trade skill for a lower rate — bring us your best and it will be

recognized. Right operator, part-time now, full-time potential.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeping Coach and Trainer
description:
Part-time contract: Approximately 20-30 hours over four to six weeks



I am a Canadian entrepreneur operating several businesses and am looking for an experienced QuickBooks Online bookkeeper to teach me how to manage my day-to-day bookkeeping.



This is not a traditional bookkeeping position. I will retain control of my records and complete the bookkeeping myself while sharing my screen with you over Zoom. Your role will be to guide me, explain the correct process, watch me enter transactions, answer questions, and help me develop reliable bookkeeping procedures.



Initial engagement



The initial engagement will consist of:



Ten sessions

Two hours per session

Approximately two or three sessions per week

Twenty hours in total

Additional sessions may be offered if the arrangement is successful



We will begin with one paid two-hour trial session.



What I need to learn



Topics may include:



Reviewing and improving my chart of accounts

Recording income and expenses correctly

Identifying which bank account received a payment

Working with more than one bank account

Categorizing transactions

Entering bills, expenses, invoices, and payments

Recording owner or shareholder transactions correctly

Understanding transfers between accounts

Matching and reconciling bank transactions

Handling credit card transactions

Understanding GST and Canadian sales tax treatment

Producing and reading basic financial reports

Correcting errors without creating additional problems

Establishing a practical monthly bookkeeping routine

Determining which matters should be referred to my Canadian accountant

Required qualifications



You must have:



Strong, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online

A solid understanding of bookkeeping and double-entry accounting

Excellent spoken English

The patience and communication skills required to teach a business owner

Experience explaining not only what to do, but why it is done

Reliable internet and the ability to meet through Zoom

Strong attention to detail

Respect for confidentiality and financial privacy



Experience with Canadian businesses, GST, corporations, shareholder accounts, and multiple business bank accounts is strongly preferred.



Important boundaries



You will normally view my QuickBooks account through screen sharing while I operate the software. I will retain control of my login credentials, records, and supporting documents.



I am looking for someone who will teach and guide me rather than simply take over the work. When an issue requires the judgment of a Canadian CPA or tax professional, I expect you to identify it rather than guess.



Schedule



Sessions will need to overlap with Mountain Time in Alberta, Canada. We can arrange mutually agreeable days and times.



Compensation



CAD-$12 per hour, based on experience, teaching ability, and knowledge of Canadian bookkeeping.



How to apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



How many years have you worked with QuickBooks Online?

Have you worked with Canadian businesses and GST? Please describe your experience.

Have you taught a business owner or staff member how to use QuickBooks?

Are you comfortable teaching while I share my screen and complete the entries myself?

What is your hourly rate?

What hours are you available in Mountain Time?

When can you start?



Please begin your application with the words “Teach, Don’t Take Over” so I know you have read the complete posting and have paid attention to the details. Thank you.

title: AI Creative Designer
description:

We are looking for a highly skilled and creative AI Creative Designer / Proposal Builder to support a growing luxury event design and production company. This role is ideal for someone who is extremely comfortable using advanced AI tools to create high-quality visual mock-ups, proposal images, event renderings, short video concepts, and polished client-facing proposals.



This person will be responsible for taking creative direction, event notes, inspiration images, color palettes, venue details, and design concepts, then turning them into elevated visuals and organized proposal materials that help clients clearly see the vision.



The ideal candidate should be highly creative, fast, detail-oriented, and experienced with tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Krea/Flux, Kling AI, Nano Banana, Canva, CapCut, and other AI design/video platforms. Proficiency in Notion is a strong plus, especially for organizing client projects, proposal notes, design tasks, and CRM updates.



Responsibilities

-Create realistic AI-generated event mock-ups for weddings, baby showers, corporate events, galas, birthdays, and luxury celebrations.

-Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Krea/Flux, Kling AI, Nano Banana, Canva, and CapCut to produce high-quality images, videos, and proposal visuals.

-Turn event design notes into detailed visual concepts, including ceremony designs, reception layouts, tablescapes, lounges, entrance 
nts, cake displays, bars, signage, floral installations, and full-room mock-ups.

-Create short AI-generated video concepts and motion visuals for client proposals, social media, and event presentations.

-Build polished, client-facing proposals using provided branding, pricing, inspiration images, AI visuals, and creative direction.

-Organize proposal pages in a clean, luxury, easy-to-understand format.

-Use ChatGPT to help refine proposal language, design descriptions, creative direction, and client-facing presentation copy.

-Make revisions based on creative feedback and detailed design notes.

-Ensure all mock-ups look realistic, elevated, properly scaled, and aligned with the client’s vision.

-Source or create visual references that match the event’s theme, color palette, and design direction.

-Assist with mood boards, design decks, visual storytelling, and presentation layouts.

-Help organize client design notes, project updates, task lists, and proposal progress in Notion, if experienced.

-Maintain a quick turnaround time of less than 24 hours for assigned designs, revisions, and video concepts.

-Communicate clearly and provide updates on assigned tasks.



Required Skills

-Strong experience with ChatGPT for prompt writing, creative direction, copy refinement, and workflow support.

-Strong experience with Midjourney or similar AI image generation tools.

-Experience with Krea/Flux for image creation, enhancement, editing, or visual refinement.

-Experience with Kling AI or similar AI video generation tools.

-Experience with Nano Banana or similar AI creative/editing tools.

-Strong experience creating realistic luxury event mock-ups, not cartoon-style or generic AI images.

-Canva design experience is required.

-CapCut or basic video editing experience is strongly preferred.

-Ability to understand luxury event design, including florals, draping, lighting, furniture, signage, linens, tablescapes, scale, and layout.

-Ability to follow creative direction closely and apply feedback quickly.

-Strong attention to detail.

-Strong organization and communication skills.

-Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

-Must be comfortable working with a fast-paced creative team.

-Must be available to actively work on designs and revisions with turnaround times under 24 hours.

-Must submit a portfolio or samples of previous design work. Applications without visual examples will not be considered.



Portfolio Requirement

Ideal candidates must submit a portfolio or examples of previous design work with their application. This can include AI-generated event mock-ups, proposal designs, mood boards, video concepts, social media visuals, branding work, or any creative projects that show the ability to produce high-quality visuals.



Applicants who have experience creating luxury event designs, wedding mock-ups, proposal decks, or AI-generated video concepts are strongly preferred.



Please include examples that show skill with tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Krea/Flux, Kling AI, Nano Banana, Canva, CapCut, or similar platforms. We are looking for someone who can create visuals that feel polished, realistic, elevated, and client-ready.



Preferred Skills

-Proficiency in Notion for project management, CRM updates, proposal organization, task tracking, and client notes.

-Experience building full design proposals, pitch decks, or client presentations.

-Experience with luxury events, weddings, corporate events, or interior/event design.

-Ability to create both still images and video mock-ups from the same event concept.

-Ability to maintain consistency across multiple visuals for one event design.

-Strong understanding of visual storytelling and client presentation flow.



Ideal Candidate

The right person for this role is someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into something visually impressive. You should understand how to make a proposal feel high-end, emotional, polished, and easy for a client to say yes to.



We need someone who can think creatively, but also follow specific notes. For example, if we ask for deep plum linens, gold chairs, acrylic signage, warm lighting, lush florals, and a luxury ballroom feel, the final image should reflect those exact details.



This role requires someone who is both artistic and organized. You should be able to create the visuals, place them into a proposal, adjust based on feedback, and help us present each event in a way that feels custom, premium, and professional.



Compensation

Monthly Pay: $300 USD per month

Approximate PHP Equivalent: ?18,369.90 PHP per month



Work Expectations

This is a remote monthly role. The designer must be able to actively work on assigned designs, proposal updates, and revisions throughout the week. Turnaround time should generally be less than 24 hours, especially for active client proposals and mock-up revisions.



We are looking for someone reliable, creative, detail-oriented, and committed to growing with the company.

About Us

We're a New Zealand-based premium Manuka honey brand selling across global markets through Shopify, Amazon, and our own e-commerce stores. 



Position Overview

Contract role, required availability: Saturday & Sunday (weekend coverage), Thursday (2-hours – meetings & training), public holidays and team leave coverage when required. The Customer Care & Order Fulfilment Assistant plays a key role in delivering exceptional customer service and ensuring the accurate, timely processing of orders. This role responds to customer queries across
, live chat, WhatsApp Meta channels via our customer ticketing system Gorgias, and processes and tracks orders across our sales channels.



Key Responsibilities

 - Customer Query Handling

 - Respond to customer queries promptly and professionally via Gorgias across
, live chat, WhatsApp, Meta 
/Instagram) channels.

 - Provide accurate, friendly, and solutions-focused support in line with New Zealand Honey Co.'s tone of voice and service standards.

- Meet response and resolution SLAs across all supported channels.

 - Use and follow the library of macros (pre-populated templates), escalating gaps or improvement opportunities to the Customer Care & Orders Team Lead.

- Escalate complex, sensitive, or VIP customer queries to the Customer Care & Orders Team Lead as needed.

 - Identify and flag recurring customer issues, product feedback, or trends to the Customer Care & Orders Team Lead.



Order Processing

 - Process and track orders accurately and in a timely manner across all sales channels, using Cin7, Shopify, Pipe17, and MCF (Multi-Channel Fulfilment).

 - Liaise with external 3PLs on delayed orders or fulfilment issues.

 - Monitor order status and proactively communicate delays, damages, or fulfilment issues to customers.

 - Action the reshipment of orders in line with company policy, ensuring accurate record-keeping.

 - Flag order damages, leaks, or 3PL fulfilment issues to the Customer Care & Orders Team Lead and Customer Operations Specialist.



Quality & Continuous Improvement

 - Maintain a high standard of accuracy in written communication, order management, and record-keeping.

 - Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and the Customer Care Handbook, raising suggested updates where relevant.

 - Actively use company approved AI-assisted tools to improve efficiency and accuracy in customer care and order operations.

 - Participate in tea
etings and one-on-one check-ins with the Customer Care & Orders Team Lead.



Qualifications & Competencies

Core Competencies

 - Customer service excellence: A genuine passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

 - Attention to detail: High accuracy in order processing, written communication, and record-keeping.

 - Communication: Clear, friendly, and professional written communication skills.

 - Organisation & time management: Able to manage multiple tickets and tasks efficiently, including during high-volume periods.

 - Problem-solving: Comfortable resolving customer issues independently and knowing when to escalate.

 - Reliability: Consistent availability for scheduled weekend, Thursday, and public holiday shifts.



Technical Competencies

 - Experience with Gorgias or similar helpdesk platforms (e.g. Freshdesk, Zendesk) across
, live chat, and social/Meta channels.

 - Familiarity with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, eBay, or Walmart is an advantage.

 - Familiarity with inventory management systems in particular Cin7 is advantageous.

 - Familiarity with project management and communication platforms such as Slack, Monday, or Airtable is an advantage.



Personal Attributes

 - Self-motivated, proactive, and solution-oriented.

 - Committed to continuous learning and development.

 - Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced environment.

 - Customer-obsessed mindset with a passion for delivering excellence.



Why Work With Us

 - Friendly, supportive team: work alongside a close-knit team that genuinely has your back and values collaboration over competition.

 - On-the-job learning & development: gain hands-on training and certification in Gorgias, building skills that go beyond the day-to-day role.

- Work from the comfort of your own home: enjoy the flexibility and comfort of a fully remote role.

- Make a genuine difference: be part of a product and team that customers love, and see the direct impact of your work on their experience.

title: Sales Representative for Merchant Processing Audits
description:
About Us

We’re a small financial firm that helps small US businesses stop overpaying on credit card processing, as well as offering a complementary bookkeeping service that you'll be compensated for selling.



The Role

Full-cycle outbound sales. You'll cold call US business owners, present a free audit offer, secure signed authorization forms, and deliver results. 



What You'll Do

    • Make cold outbound calls to small US businesses

    • Introduce a free, no-risk audit offer and secure signed authorization forms

    • Follow up with prospects to keep deals moving

    • Deliver audit results to clients and confirm next steps

    • Introduce an additional service where relevant (additional commission applies)

    • Log all activity in the CRM



Requirements

    • 1+ years of B2B cold calling, appointment setting, or phone sales experience

    • Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent

    • Comfortable with high-volume outbound dialing

    • Self-motivated and disciplined

    • Reliable internet, quiet workspace, own computer and headset

    • Available to work US business hours



Compensation

    • Base: $200/month

    • Commission: 30% of the first?month fee collected from each client you close (avg. $60/client)

    • Additional Commission: 30% of the first-month fee collected from each bookkeeping client you secure (avg. $240/client)

    • Paid monthly on all collected revenue



What We Provide

    • Generous bonuses for exceeding KPIs

    • Reliable, on-time monthly pay

    • Long-term growth opportunity as the client base expands



How to Apply

Send:

    1. A 2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your cold calling or phone sales experience

    2. Your resume or summary of relevant experience

title: Content Creator & Video Editor (Remote) – First Hire, Grow Into Head of Content
description:
If you’re an ambitious editor who wants ONE brand to go deep with instead of juggling random client gigs, this is for you.



We’re building a founder-led personal brand in high-end kitchen & bath remodeling. You’ll be the first full-time content hire and own the day-to-day content engine from idea to publish.



A. What You’ll Do

- Own the content engine from strategy to publishing  

- Plan the content calendar for YouTube, Shorts, Reels, TikTok, and the podcast  

- Edit high-quality short-form and long-form content  

- Produce and edit podcast episodes (video and audio)  

- Publish and manage content across platforms  

- Track performance, experiment with new ideas, and double down on what works  



If you enjoy building brands, testing ideas, and seeing your work directly drive growth, you’ll like this role.



B. Who You Are

- You live and breathe content and study what keeps people watching  

- You’re an excellent editor for both short-form and long-form  

- You think like an owner and proactively improve ideas  

- You move quickly, take feedback well, and are always looking to improve  

- We care far more about your skill and hunger than your résumé  



This is ideal if you’re 1–3 years into your creator career and want a long-term partner to grow with.



C. Compensation

- Fully remote, full-time  

- Base: $1,200–$1,500 USD/month, depending on experience  

- 2% commission on collected revenue from clients whose first interaction with us came through content you created  



To make the upside real:

- Average project value: ~$30,000

- If your content adds 2 extra projects/month (~$60,000), your commission is about $1,200/month

- As content-driven revenue grows, your earnings grow with it  



You help us win; you share in the win.



D. How to Apply

Instead of a résumé, show us what you can do. Create a compelling 90-second podcast intro using the raw footage below:







We’re looking for storytelling, pacing, hooks, captions, motion graphics, and sound design that keep people watching. If your work stands out, we’ll reach out to schedule an interview. Your work is your application.

title: Bilingual Regional Financial Coordinator – Spanish/English | Full-Time | Remote
description:
Bilingual Regional Financial Coordinator – Spanish/English speaking | Full-Time | Remote

Location: Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Business Hours

Compensation: Based on experience

Type: Long-Term | Full-Time

Openings: 3 full-time roles available



About the Role

We are hiring Bilingual Regional Financial Coordinators to support patient account management for a U.S.-based healthcare organization. This role is focused on working with patient accounts, following up on delinquent balances, and helping patients understand next steps related to their account. The ideal candidate is fluent in Spanish and English, comfortable making outbound calls, and has experience in healthcare, billing, insurance, patient ledgers, or account follow-up.



What You’ll Do

Patient Account Follow-Up

Call patients to follow up on delinquent accounts

Discuss outstanding balances professionally and respectfully

Help patients understand account status and payment next steps

Document all call outcomes and follow-up notes accurately

Follow established scripts and account follow-up processes



Financial Coordination Support

Review patient ledgers and account details

Identify account balances, payments, adjustments, and insurance activity

Flag discrepancies or unclear account issues for review

Support the team with organized account documentation

Help maintain accurate patient financial records



Bilingual Communication

Communicate clearly with patients in both Spanish and English

Provide warm, professional, and respectful support

Use strong judgment when discussing sensitive financial matters

Maintain patient confidentiality at all times



Required Experience

Fluent in Spanish and English

Experience with outbound calling or patient/customer account follow-up

Strong communication skills by phone

Comfortable discussing balances or delinquent accounts

Strong attention to detail and documentation habits

Professional, patient, and calm communication style

Able to work full-time during U.S. business hours



Nice to Have

Healthcare, dental, or orthodontic billing experience

Experience reviewing patient ledgers

Understanding of insurance payments, adjustments, balances, and account aging

Experience with collections, AR follow-up, or payment coordination

Experience using healthcare practice management systems or CRM tools



What Success Looks Like

Patients are contacted consistently and professionally

Delinquent accounts are followed up on according to process

Account notes are accurate and complete

Patient communication is respectful and clear

Issues or discrepancies are escalated appropriately

The team has reliable support managing patient account follow-up



Who This Role Is Best For



This role is best for someone who:

Is fluent in Spanish and English

Is comfortable making phone calls

Has experience with patient accounts, billing, or financial follow-up

Communicates with empathy and professionalism

Is organized and detail-oriented

Wants a stable, long-term full-time role



To Apply

Please submit the following:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your experience with:

- Spanish/English communication

- Patient account follow-up

- Billing, insurance, or healthcare support

3. Any healthcare, dental, or financial systems you have used



Subject Line: Bilingual Financial Coordinator – [Your Full Name]



We are hiring 3 full-time candidates and reviewing applications immediately. If you are bilingual in Spanish and English and have experience supporting patient accounts or healthcare billing, we would love to hear from you.

title: Operations Assistant for Real Estate Company
description:
Part-Time Operations Assistant — Family-Owned Real Estate Company (Long-Term Role)

About Us

We are a family-owned real estate lending and investment company based in Houston, Texas. We make short-term real estate loans to investors, invest in long-term mortgage notes, and own and manage a portfolio of single-family rental homes. We've been building this business for over 15 years, and we are always learning and growing!



We are a small "mom-and-pop" shop — not a big corporate call center. That means the person we hire actually matters. You'll work directly with the owners, see how the whole business fits together, and your work will make a real, visible difference. When we hire, we're investing in a long-term relationship. We want someone who wants to stay and grow with us.



We are NOT looking for a "checklist" person. We're looking for a teammate who wants to learn our business, take ownership of their work, and grow as we continue to scale.





The Role

You will be one of our Operations Assistants — the "owner" of the day-to-day operations across both sides of our business: lending and property management. You'll be trained on and work in our lending software and our property management software, and you'll help us keep both engines running smoothly.



This is initially a part-time hire for this role, potentially growing into a full time role, so you'll get deep training directly from the owners on day one. Some days/weeks are really busy, other times it's quieter. When it's quiet, we'll have "side projects" you'll assist us with — there's always something interesting to learn here.

What You'll Own — Lending Operations

Loan processing and data entry for new and existing borrowers

Coordinating loan closings with title companies, attorneys, and vendors

Ordering and/or tracking appraisals, title work, and insurance

Posting and updating loan payments and monitoring collections

Managing construction draw requests and documentation

Tax and insurance monitoring

Borrower communications, notices, and persistent follow-up on outstanding items

Keeping loan records, checklists, and status trackers accurate and current

What You'll Own — Property Management

Monitoring and following up on rent collection and late payments

Coordinating maintenance and repairs with tenants and vendors — triaging what's urgent, dispatching, and following up until the job is done

Communicating professionally and promptly with tenants and vendors

Supporting the leasing process: listings, applications, screening, move-ins and move-outs

Keeping property, tenant, and vendor records accurate and current

Auditing tenant files

Property tax protest updates

Insurance quotes and updates on properties

Across Both

Answering and making professional phone calls as needed

Online research and document/spreadsheet organization

Jumping in wherever the business needs you





We Embrace AI — And We Want You To, Too

We use AI tools (like Gemini) throughout our business — for drafting documents, organizing information, summarizing, and automating repetitive work. We want to be clear about our philosophy: we are not using AI to replace people. We're using it to make everyone on our team better at their job.



We're looking for someone who is curious and open to learning how to work with AI — someone excited to use these tools to work smarter, get more done, and take on more interesting work. You don't need to be an expert; we'll teach you how we use it. You just need to be open, curious, and willing to learn. If you already use AI tools in your work, tell us about it in your application!





What Makes This Different: Roles, Not Tasks

The most important thing to understand: we want you to own outcomes, not just check off tasks.



If a task is "follow up with a borrower" or "follow up on a repair," we don't mean send one message and move on. We mean stay on it until it's actually resolved — follow up again, and again if needed.

When you hit a question you can't answer, look for the answer first — check our written procedures, look at how it was handled before, think it through — then come to us with options and a recommendation, not just the problem. ("Here's what happened, here are two ways we could handle it, I recommend this one" — that's the person we want.)

Because we're a small shop, we need you to be flexible and willing to jump in where you're needed, even outside your main area.





How We Work Together

Daily end-of-day handoff. At the end of each workday, you'll close out your day with a simple routine, sorting every open item into one of three buckets: Complete (done), Pending (in progress, with a note on what you're waiting for and when you'll follow up), or Needs More Info (stuck, needs a decision). Nothing falls through the cracks.



Weekly review and training. Once a week, we'll spend 20–30 minutes together where you sum up the work that got accomplished during the week: loans that closed, repairs resolved, rent collected, follow-ups that reached the finish line, problems solved. This helps us look ahead to the next week. We measure results, not activity, and we'll invest in your training and growth.





Qualities We Can't Teach

Integrity — Open, honest communication matters more than being perfect. If a mistake happens or you're stuck, tell us. Don't disappear. We understand that it will "feel" overwhelming… until it's not.

Commitment — We want a long-term teammate. We invest heavily in training and want someone who wants to stay.

Desire to learn — Ask questions. Learn our business. Embrace new tools. Become part of our growth.

Resourcefulness — You look for answers first and bring options, not just questions. Show up for meetings prepared.

Follow-through — You own outcomes and don't let things drop.

Detail-oriented — You notice the small things. Accuracy matters to you and you pride yourself on getting it right the first time.





Requirements

Fluent, professional English — spoken and written (this is essential)

Ability to work independently and juggle multiple deadlines

Reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer and phone, and ideally a backup for power/internet outages

Comfortable with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, Gemini)

Open and curious about using AI tools to work smarter (we'll train you on how we use them)

Able to learn easy-to-use lending and property management software

Detail-oriented, highly organized, dependable, and a strong communicator

Need to be able to have strong overlap with the US Central Time business day (this is a set schedule we'll agree on together) 



Hours & Growth

Part-time: ~20-25 hours/week, on a set schedule aligned with US Central Time business hours

Room to grow: as we scale and add more part-time assistants to the team, there's a clear path to more responsibility and leadership in our operations

Pay based on experience; we also believe in rewarding loyalty and strong performance over time





How to Apply

We personally read and review every application. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!



1. So we know you read the full description, please use this exact subject line: Rosegate Ops — Grow With Us



2. In the body of your application, answer these questions: 

1. What is your favorite way to use AI tools to make your daily work more efficient, and what is one limitation you’ve noticed about them? 

2. Tell us about a frustrating experience in a previous role - what was the issue and what workaround did you come up with?



3. A short video (2–3 minutes). Send a link to a simple phone or Loom recording telling us: why you'd be a great fit, something interesting about yourself, and what you like to do in your spare time. 



4. Anything else you'd like us to know — plus any questions you have for us. We'll happily answer them.



Thank you for reading all the way through. We're excited to find the right person to grow with us!

title: 3D CAD Drafter (AutoCAD) - Events, Trade Shows & Custom Fabrication
description:
3D CAD DRAFTER (AUTOCAD) - EVENTS, TRADE SHOWS & CUSTOM FABRICATION

Company: George Quan Design LLC / Wizard Studios / Blackhouse NYC

Location: Remote (Philippines-based or US Eastern-based)

Schedule: PH hours or US Eastern hours - your choice

Type: Full-time or Part-time



ABOUT US

We are a scenic and experiential design studio. We design and produce environments for corporate events, trade shows, brand activations, and live experiences. Our work moves fast, gets built for real, and shows up in front of real audiences on a hard deadline.



We already work with a small distributed team in the Philippines and are looking to add a strong 3D drafter to the group.



THE ROLE

You will take design intent - sketches, references, rough concepts, sometimes napkin-level direction - and turn it into clean, accurate 3D models in AutoCAD that our fabrication partners can actually build from.

This is not a rendering job and it is not a decorative job. This is a "will it build correctly and will the panels line up on site" job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Build accurate 3D models in AutoCAD from design concepts, reference imagery, and dimensioned direction

Produce clean geometry that translates cleanly to fabrication and downstream software

Model scenic elements: walls, kiosks, backdrops, custom furniture, signage structures, storefronts, stage elements, hanging structures

Keep files organized, layered, and named so someone else can open them and understand them

Turn around revisions quickly during active production weeks

Communicate clearly about what is and is not resolvable in the model



REQUIREMENTS



Strong, demonstrable AutoCAD 3D modeling skills (not just 2D drafting)

Ability to model to real dimensions and real material thicknesses

Comfort reading and working from design drawings, sketches, and reference photos

Clean file hygiene: layers, blocks, naming, units

Reliable communication and responsiveness during your working hours

Ability to hit deadlines in a production environment where the show date does not move

English communication sufficient for written direction, markups, and calls



HUGE BONUS (PLEASE HIGHLIGHT IF YOU HAVE IT)



CNC fabrication experience - modeling with cut files, nesting, tool paths, sheet goods, and shop realities in mind

Events, trade show, exhibit, or scenic experience

Experience coordinating with fabrication shops

Familiarity with Vectorworks, SketchUp, Rhino, Fusion 360, Twinmotion, or Blender

Experience preparing models for visualization or rendering handoff



SOFTWARE & LICENSING



Full-time hires: We will pay for your AutoCAD subscription.

Part-time hires: You must bring your own AutoCAD subscription. Pay rate is negotiable slightly higher to account for this.



COMPENSATION

Negotiable and based on experience, portfolio quality, and whether you are full-time or part-time. Tell us your rate.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:



Your portfolio - we care most about 3D models, screenshots of your model geometry (wireframe or shaded viewport is great), and anything that was actually built

A short note on your AutoCAD 3D experience specifically

Whether you have CNC or fabrication experience, and what kind

Your availability (full-time or part-time), preferred time zone (PH or US Eastern), and your rate

Whether you currently hold an AutoCAD subscription



Applications without a portfolio or work samples will not be reviewed.

title: Virtual Assistant / Social Media Content Creator (Part-Time, Flexible)
description:
Virtual Assistant / Social Media Content Creator (Part-Time, Flexible)



I'm looking for a creative Virtual Assistant who loves turning everyday 
nts into engaging social media content.



We're Realtors in Burlington, Ontario, and often take photos and videos while out working, touring homes, attending events, exploring local businesses, or just capturing things that would interest my audience.



The problem isn't creating the content. It's actually turning it into great posts.



What you'll do:



I'll send you photos, video clips, ideas, or voice notes throughout the week.



Your job is to:



Turn them into Instagram Reels, Stories,
 posts, LinkedIn content, and short videos.

Add captions, music, transitions, subtitles, and graphics where appropriate.

Know what works on different platforms.

Repurpose one piece of content into multiple posts.

Suggest content ideas from the material I send you.

Occasionally create carousels or simple graphics.

Schedule posts if needed.



Usually I won't know exactly what I want. I'll simply send you a folder of videos and say, "See what you can make."



I'm looking for someone who enjoys that creative freedom.



What I'm looking for

Strong video editing skills (CapCut, Canva, Adobe Express or similar)

Excellent English writing skills

Understands Instagram,
 and 

Can make content that feels authentic rather than overly polished

Able to work independently without needing detailed instructions

Organized and responsive

Familiar with real estate marketing is a bonus, but not required



Hours: Very flexible. Probably 3-10 hours per week to start, with room to grow if we're a good fit.



To apply please send:

A few examples of social media content you've created

The software you use

Your hourly rate

A short note explaining why you'd be a good fit



I'm looking for someone I can build a long-term working relationship with. If you're creative, reliable, and can consistently turn raw content into posts people actually want to watch, I'd love to hear from you.

title: SaaS Sales Executive
description:

Healthcare Market Intelligence & Content Specialist



Hiring a Healthcare Market Intelligence & Content Specialist to support our AI Navigation and Indoor Wayfinding solutions for hospitals and healthcare organizations.

Responsibilities



* Monitor online market signals, industry news, community publications, and LinkedIn for hospital expansions, renovations, new construction, and other opportunities.

* Research and write professional case studies demonstrating the measurable benefits of indoor wayfinding technologies.

* Develop evidence-based articles supporting improvements in patient experience, accessibility, staff efficiency, and hospital operations.

### Qualifications

 writing skills.

* Experience using CRM software (GoHighLevel preferred).

* Able to write original business content without relying on AI-generated writing.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated.



### Preferred



* Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, marketing, journalism, business research, or communications.

* Experience writing articles, case studies, newsletters, or professional content.



Success in This Role



You enjoy researching, writing, and identifying organizations that are likely to benefit from new technology. Your work helps educate the market and equips our Sales Development Representatives with qualified opportunities and professional materials that support customer conversations.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role is measured by consistency, quality, and attention to detail.



Identify and document a minimum of (see below) qualified healthcare organizations every four (4) hours based on predefined market signals.

or a new hire:



Weeks 1–2: 5–8 qualified organizations per 4 hours

Weeks 3–4: 8–12

After 60 days: 10–15 consistently per 4 hour shift



Monitor LinkedIn, healthcare news sources, community publications, and organization announcements throughout the workday.

Regularly engage with relevant LinkedIn content by liking and following industry discussions to improve the relevance of future content surfaced by the LinkedIn algorithm.

Identify organizations advertising positions related to Patient Navigation, Patient Experience, Patient Success, Patient Access, Patient Throughput, Care Management, and Director-level leadership roles, as these often indicate organizations investing in patient journey improvements.

For each qualified organization, provide the Sales Development Representative with:

Organization name

Relevant contact name(s) and title(s)

LinkedIn profile link(s)

Supporting market signal or evidence for qualification

Produce well-researched case studies and evidence-based content that support the value of AI-powered indoor wayfinding technologies.

Maintain accurate CRM records and supporting documentation for all assigned activities.



Expanded Details:



# Performance Expectations & Commission Qualification



Our goal is to identify organizations that are actively entering a buying cycle, not simply organizations that exist within our target market. Quality is valued over quantity.



## Daily Performance Expectations (4-Hour Shift)



Candidates are expected to:



* Identify **8–12 qualified organizations** per 4-hour shift.

* Monitor LinkedIn, healthcare news, community publications, press releases, company websites, and other public sources for market signals.

* Regularly engage with relevant LinkedIn content to strengthen their professional network and improve the relevance of industry content surfaced in their feed.

* Grow their professional LinkedIn network by connecting with individuals relevant to our target industries and Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs).

* Research organizations hiring for positions such as:



  * Patient Navigation

  * Patient Experience

  * Patient Success

  * Patient Access

  * Patient Throughput

  * Care Management

  * Director, Vice President, or Executive leadership roles related to these functions

* Provide the Sales Development Representative (SDR) with:



  * Organization name

  * Primary market signal(s)

  * Contact name(s)

  * Title(s)

  * LinkedIn profile link(s)

  * Supporting notes that explain why the organization may be entering a buying cycle



## Buying Signal Examples



Examples of market signals include:



* Hospital construction or campus expansion

* Facility renovation or modernization projects

* New outpatient facilities or medical office buildings

* Patient experience or accessibility initiatives

* AI or digital transformation announcements

* Executive leadership changes

* New leadership positions related to patient access, navigation, or operations

* Public announcements regarding operational improvement initiatives

* Industry awards or recognition related to patient experience

* Conference presentations or published articles indicating strategic investment priorities



## Hot Lead Qualification



A lead may qualify as a **Hot Lead** when it demonstrates multiple indicators that the organization is actively preparing for or evaluating a solution.



To qualify, a lead should generally include:



* Three or more independent buying signals

* At least one identified executive or director-level decision maker

* Evidence that the activity or announcement is recent and relevant

* Complete supporting documentation entered into the CRM before SDR outreach begins



## Commission Eligibility



Enhanced referral commissions may be earned when:



* The candidate identifies and documents a qualified Hot Lead.

* The opportunity is accepted by Sales Development as meeting the Hot Lead criteria.

* The opportunity is properly attributed to the candidate in the CRM before sales engagement begins.

* The organization progresses into an active sales opportunity in accordance with Vantage Data Group's referral and commission policies.



Our objective is to reward candidates who consistently identify high-quality opportunities that create meaningful business conversations and contribute to long-term customer relationships.



Bonus (no cap) Eligibility Shared with qualified candidates during interview process.

Linkedin Outreach and engagement must be performed during US EST-PST hours

title: Next Generation Tech Lead Needed Now – Industry Disrupting Multi Media Platform
description:
Seeking a growth oriented, hands on, technically competent individual who is driven to learn and ready to step into a technical lead role while architecting and implementing a one of a kind AI driven application. This project uses Postgres with JSONB, pgvector, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3 bucket design, and a retrieval augmented generation pipeline built with tools such as LlamaIndex, Voyager, or similar frameworks.

The role involves leading edge design for chunking and embedding workflows for large documents, building metadata schemas, integrating vector search with structured retrieval logic, and constructing clean pipelines that feed context into large language model endpoints. You will also assist with proper setup and integration of Visual Studio on the client’s development machine, and demonstrate solid practical experience with AWS services and infrastructure.

Being driven to learn — and ideally having direct experience working with Anthropic’s Claude models — is important for this role. This includes structured JSON based instruction design, awareness of JSON vs JSONB behavior, and context driven prompt construction. You must be able to translate high level functional requirements into clear technical tasks, supervise a development team from the ground up, set realistic estimates, track progress against those estimates, and ensure developers deliver within reasonable and agreed upon timeframes.

This includes recognizing legitimate delays or underestimates when they occur, adjusting timelines when appropriate, and firmly addressing situations where work pace or effort does not align with expectations. The role requires someone confident enough to communicate directly with the founder when a developer is not meeting commitments, and strong enough to enforce a disciplined, results driven workflow. You must also administer and strictly enforce Git discipline to ensure code integrity, and deliver a working MVP with solid backend architecture, API endpoints, database structure, and retrieval logic.

This is a hands on position with some development already in progress for a start up that is currently being self funded by a disabled veteran. The initial build period — to push significantly past the MVP stage — will be compensated at a low hourly rate, with the understanding that substantial financial growth, long term involvement, and possible share ownership are available as the project moves into full launch and funding.



What “Ready to Leap Forward” Really Means

Being ready to leap forward means stepping into a role where leadership is measured by action, accountability, and results. It means setting clear estimates, tracking progress against those estimates, and ensuring developers deliver within reasonable and agreed upon timeframes. It means recognizing legitimate delays when they occur — whether due to complexity, unforeseen obstacles, or changes in requirements — while also addressing situations where pace, effort, or commitment does not align with expectations. It requires the confidence to communicate directly with the founder when a developer is not meeting commitments, and the strength to enforce a disciplined, results driven workflow. This role is for someone who is comfortable making decisions, holding others accountable, and keeping the project moving forward without excuses.

To clarify, there are further instructions in this job description that appear later. We will only shortlist candidates who use 10+ AP on this post and show they have fully read and understood this ad. Laid-Back eBay VA (Mostly Vintage Clothing, Modern Home Goods, & Collectibles)



Job Type: Part-Time / Gig-Based (Flexible): 



Aloha! 

Are you an eBay enthusiast who loves the thrill of the hunt? Do you know how to spot the unique selling points of a vintage jacket, a cool collectible, or a high-quality piece of modern home decor? If so, we’d love to have you hang out and work with us!

We’re a growing e-commerce shop specializing in a fun, eclectic mix of vintage apparel, modern home goods, and unique collectibles. We’re looking for a reliable, sharp, and friendly Virtual Assistant to take over our daily eBay drafting. If you love variety, have a great eye for detail, and want a low-stress, flexible gig, this is the perfect spot for you.



???? What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):



Grab Photos from Google Drive: We’ll upload organized folders of item photos and measurements for you to work from.

Build Great Titles: Craft accurate, keyword-rich listing titles that grab attention.

Fill Out Item Specifics:

For Clothing: Identify the brand, size, material, condition, and style tags (vintage, streetwear, Y2K) straight from the photos.

For Home Goods/Collectibles: Spot makers' marks, material types, model numbers, and call out any cosmetic flaws so our buyers know exactly what they're getting.

Double-Check AI Descriptions: Use eBay’s built-in AI tool to generate descriptions, but keep a sharp eye on them—edit for absolute accuracy so we prevent returns.

Optimize for SEO: Drop strategic keywords into the titles and item specifics so our inventory ranks high in eBay searches.

Save as Drafts: You get to do the fun part! Just get the listings looking beautiful and save them as drafts in our Seller Hub. We handle all the pricing and final publishing.



What We’re Looking For (Qualifications):

Some eBay & Clothing Experience: You should have a bit of hands-on experience navigating the eBay Seller Hub and a general familiarity with clothing brands.

Multi-Category Curiosity: Experience listing thrifted items or collectibles is a huge plus! You should know how to look closely at photos for serial numbers or brand tags.

Solid Written English: Good grammar and spelling keep our shop looking professional.

Reliable Setup: A dependable computer/laptop and a stable internet connection.

An Investigative Mindset: Since we deal with unique items, you should enjoy doing a quick Google search to figure out exactly what a vintage item or collectible is.



What’s In It For You (Perks):

Zero Pricing Stress: You don't have to worry about market research or pricing battles. You just build the drafts, and we take care of the rest.

A Fun, Diverse Workflow: You won’t get bored entering data for 50 identical t-shirts. Our inventory changes constantly and keeps things interesting!

100% Flexible Schedule: Work whenever fits your lifestyle, day or night. As long as the drafts get done, we’re happy.



How to Apply:

If you’re ready to jump in, send us a message with:

A quick intro about your eBay experience.

A screenshot of your internet speed test.

Tell us about the coolest, weirdest, or most unique used item or collectible you’ve ever seen or listed!

Can't wait to chat and build something great together!

title: Experienced Appointment Setter | Cold Caller | B2B
description:
# Experienced Appointment Setter / Cold Caller (B2B Sales)



## About Us



We are a growing U.S.-based merchant processing company helping businesses lower their payment processing costs and improve their payment solutions.



We are seeking a motivated and confident appointment setter who enjoys speaking with business owners, making outbound calls, and setting qualified meetings for our sales team.



This is a long-term opportunity with strong income potential for the right person.



## Compensation



* Base Salary: **$600-$800 USD/month** (based on experience and performance)

* Performance Bonuses Available

* Recurring Commission Opportunity



Top performers have the potential to significantly increase their monthly earnings through commissions and long-term growth within the company.



## Responsibilities



* Make outbound calls to small and medium-sized businesses in the United States

* Speak directly with business owners and decision-makers

* Qualify prospects and identify interest in our services

* Schedule appointments on our team's calendar

* Update CRM notes and maintain organized records

* Conduct follow-up calls when necessary



## What We Provide



* Leads and business contact lists

* Scripts and training

* CRM and appointment-setting systems

* Ongoing coaching and support

* Long-term growth opportunities



## Requirements



* Excellent English communication skills

* Confident speaking voice with clear pronunciation

* Previous appointment setting, cold calling, or sales experience preferred

* Experience in B2B sales, merchant services, real estate, insurance, SaaS, solar, or similar industries is a plus but not required

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet work environment

* Positive attitude and willingness to learn



## Ideal Candidate



You are:



* Energetic and self-motivated

* Comfortable handling objections

* Persistent and resilient

* Goal-oriented and competitive

* Excited about earning commissions in addition to your base pay



## Application Instructions (Please Read Carefully)



Attention to detail is extremely important in this role. To help us identify candidates who follow instructions, please complete the following steps:



### Step 1:



Submit your resume.



### Step 2:



Include a 60-second voice recording using Vocaroo or Loom.



**The FIRST sentence of your recording must be:**



> "[Name of the largest city by population in the United States], this is [Your Name]..."



For example:



> "New York City, this is John Smith..."



This helps us quickly identify applicants who carefully read instructions.



### Step 3:



In the remainder of the recording, please briefly discuss:



* Your appointment setting or sales experience

* Industries you have worked in

* Your biggest sales achievement or KPI

* Why you believe you would be a good fit for this role

* Your expected salary within our posted range

* Any sales tools, CRMs, dialers, or software you have experience using



### Step 4:



When submitting your application, please begin your message with the following sentence:



> **"I have carefully read and followed all application instructions."**



Applications that include this statement and correctly follow the voice recording instructions will be prioritized.



We are looking to hire quickly and are excited to meet driven individuals seeking a long-term opportunity with growth potential.
