Modern Edison Electric has been in business since 2015, owner-operated and built from the ground up. We specialize in preventing electrical fires in historic homes across Sacramento and the surrounding areas — through panel upgrades, full house rewires, and fire safety inspections. Our clients are homeowners who take pride in their properties and trust us to protect them.

We are a systems-first company. We believe that repeatable processes, clear documentation, and smart automation are what allow a small team to do big work. We are constantly building and refining our SOPs — and we need someone who thinks the same way. We’re growing and need a sharp, AI-forward VA to help us run smoothly every day.



Key Responsibilities:

Permit & Documentation Management

• Pull permits and prepare necessary documentation for residential electrical projects

• Ensure accuracy and timely submission of all paperwork to the appropriate departments

Supplier Coordination

• Communicate with suppliers to order, track, and confirm delivery of materials

• Resolve issues related to supply chain delays or changes

Building Department & Inspector Liaison

• Schedule inspections with local building departments and inspectors

• Maintain compliance with relevant building codes and regulations

Client Communication

• Manage the owner’s calendar and schedule appointments

• Regularly update clients on project status and respond promptly to inquiries in a professional tone

• Handle inbound
s, messages, and follow-ups

• Take and return calls from potential leads and coordinate follow-ups

QuickBooks, Invoicing & Job Costing

• Create and send invoices using QuickBooks and follow up on unpaid balances

• Conduct job costing to ensure accuracy in tracking project financials

SOP Development & Process Improvement

• Track leads and update our CRM

• Follow, improve, and create SOPs to ensure consistency and quality across all recurring tasks

• Conduct research to identify efficiency improvements and cost-saving opportunities

• Collaborate with the owner to support a culture of process-driven work and AI-assisted automation

General Administrative Support

• Prepare documents, proposals, and reports

• Coordinate schedules and appointments with adequate preparation

• Send a daily End of Day report to the owner

• Handle admin tasks and keep operations running smoothly



Qualifications:

• AI-first mindset — you reach for ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools before asking for help. You use AI to build, not just to draft
s

• Systems builder — you don’t just complete tasks, you create repeatable processes, SOPs, and automations that remove bottlenecks

• Self-directed from Day 1 — minimal hand-holding required. You figure things out, take ownership, and come to your boss with solutions, not just problems

• 3–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, VA, or operations coordinator — required

• Experience in the construction or residential building industry — preferred

• Familiar with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, Zapier, Make, or similar) and actively uses them to get more done

• Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Drive)

• Familiarity with project management tools (Notion, Trello, Asana, or similar) — a plus

• Strong written English and excellent verbal communication

• Detail-oriented and proactive — you catch things before they become problems

• Able to manage multiple tasks independently with strong organizational and time management skills

• Available during Pacific Time zone business hours

• Reliable internet (minimum 25 Mbps) and a quiet workspace





Benefits:

? No daily commute — fully remote position

? Independent work structure

? Healthy work-life balance

? Health plan allowance / HMO

? Paid Time Off (PTO) days

? Sick Leave days

? Maternity Leave days

? Christmas Bonus

1. What do you know about Modern Edison Electric? Tell us what we do, who we serve, and why that matters to you.

2. Walk us through a specific example of how you have used AI as a real work tool — not just for writing
s. Show us how you used it to complete a task, build a process, solve a problem, or save time. Be specific: what tool, what task, what result.

title: EA/GHL/Lead Calling & Nurturing /Appointment Setting
description:
I am looking for an executive assistant. My wife, Laura, and I own an event center in Southern Indiana of the United States. Weddings currently represent 95% of our events.





Most of the day you will be nurturing and responding to leads (mostly brides) through SMS and appointment setting through GHL for the wedding venue. You will also need to? answer calls and be able to nurture some leads through phone conversations as well. Strong, clear, native English is important. We are looking for a positive, happy, energetic, warm, confident people-person.



The Executive Assistant part is that Laura and I will give you tasks that will help make the venue and business more efficient. For instance, you will do market research on all of the venues within 90 minutes of us and compare our pricing, and offerings to theirs, as well as analyze their online presence. You will need to create quotes for sales tours, set up accounts for booked clients in our event planning portal, and manually enter in/log payments that come in.



There will be some personal tasks? when we ?need help p?lanning trips or need administrative help.



We already assume and want you to have a great personal life of your own. We are sensitive to that, but we will need to be able to call and text you when you are working for/with us. Good, consistent, and reliable communication will be very important to us! You will need reliable internet and power, as well as a backup plan for outages.



It is easy for me to say, but I believe we are easy to work for, fun, and caring. We don’t want your tasks or life to be mundane. We see this as a partnership. We want you to feel like this is YOUR business and for you to take personal ownership of it and personally get excited when we do well. I know those are high hopes, but that is our desire.



We are generally open from 9am-9pm EST/EDT/Indianapolis/New York time. That is when the lead nurturing will happen the most. Our intention is to get a feel for applicants and schedules, but we anticipate hire at least one main and maybe two other assistants for this.



Please let me know if you have questions.



Most sincerely,



Chris Duvall

title: Long-Form Direct Response Copywriter
description:
We are looking for an experienced direct response copywriter to help us create high-volume, long-form
 ads for an established e-commerce brand in the emergency preparedness and survival space.



This is not a general content writing, social media management, or SEO role.



We need someone who understands how to write copy that sells.



The ads you will create are similar to:



* VSL scripts

* Advertorials

* Long-form
 primary text

* Story-driven sales letters

* Direct response
 copy

* Native-style ads that look and read like real
 posts



Our ads are often 1,500–4,000 words and use storytelling, curiosity, fear, problem awareness, product education, objection handling, and a delayed product reveal to drive sales.



The writing needs to feel natural and believable, while still being built around strong direct response principles.



What You Will Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be researching, developing, and writing long-form direct response ads for our products.



You will:



* Write long-form
 ad copy

* Develop new hooks, leads, stories, angles, and mechanisms

* Turn winning concepts into multiple new variations

* Research the target audience, competitors, products, and market

* Review ad performance and use the data to guide future concepts

* Write advertorial-style and VSL-style copy when needed

* Improve existing winning ads without simply rewriting them

* Produce a consistent volume of high-quality new concepts every week

* Work closely with our creative strategy and media buying team



We will provide product information, previous winning ads, audience research, brand context, and feedback.



You must be able to take that information and turn it into persuasive copy without needing every sentence outlined for you.



What We Are Looking For



We care about experience and results much more than degrees or certifications.



The ideal candidate has:



* Real experience writing direct response copy

* Experience with e-commerce, supplements, survival, health, finance, information products, or another competitive direct response market

* Experience writing VSLs, advertorials, sales letters, long-form ads, or
 campaigns

* A strong understanding of hooks, leads, mechanisms, awareness levels, objections, offers, and calls to action

* The ability to make complicated product features easy to understand

* The ability to write like a real person instead of a polished corporate brand

* Strong research skills

* The ability to create many different angles without repeating the same story

* Experience using ad performance data to improve future copy

* Strong written English

* The ability to accept direct feedback and revise quickly



This Role Is Not a Fit If



Please do not apply if your experience is mainly:



* SEO blog writing

* Generic social media captions

* Corporate content

* Academic writing

* Branding without direct response

* AI-generated content with limited editing

* Graphic design without copywriting experience

* General marketing courses without proven campaign work



We use AI tools internally, and you may use them as part of your process.



However, we are not looking for someone who simply enters prompts and submits the first output.



You must understand direct response marketing well enough to judge, improve, and rewrite the copy yourself.



The Writing Style



Our best ads do not sound like traditional advertisements.



They often read like:



* A personal
 post

* A confession

* A warning from a friend

* A story involving someone close to an industry or institution

* An advertorial with a strong narrative

* A VSL written in the voice of a normal customer



Pay & Perks



* Competitive pay based on skill, experience, and output

* Potential for raises and large bonuses based on ad performance

* Flexible working hours, but you must be responsive and meet deadlines

* Long-term opportunity to improve and grow with our team



How to Apply



Follow these exact instructions. Applications that do not follow this format will not be considered.



1. Tell me about your direct-response copywriting experience in 75 words or fewer. Do not include degrees, certifications, or unrelated experience.

2. Provide links to your two best direct-response ads, VSLs, advertorials, or sales pages. Briefly include any available performance results, such as ad spend, revenue, ROAS, CPA, or conversion rate.

title: Personal Brand Manager + Executive Assistant
description:
ABOUT US



We're a UK investment company led by a founder with a growing public profile — author, investor, active on LinkedIn. The brand drives the business: it's how deals, press, and opportunities find us. Your job is to run the machine behind it so the founder only does the things only he can do.



You'll report directly to the founder. Small team, fast-moving, long-term role — we want someone who grows with us over years, not months.



THE ROLE



One person, three hats:



1. LinkedIn & Personal Brand (50%)



Own the content calendar: schedule posts from the founder's drafts and voice notes, keep the pipeline full

Repurpose content: turn long posts into shorter ones, pull quotes into Canva graphics (to our brand guidelines — templates provided)

Manage the inbox: triage DMs and connection requests daily, flag high-value conversations, draft replies for approval

Engagement: monitor comments on our posts and draft responses; track target accounts we should be engaging with

Report weekly: followers, impressions, top posts, DM conversations opened



2. PR & Visibility (20%)



Monitor Qwoted (and similar journalist-request platforms) daily for relevant opportunities

Draft pitches in the founder's voice for his approval — speed matters, these expire fast

Track placements and maintain an up-to-date press kit and bio



3. Executive Assistant (30%)



Morning briefing prepared before the UK day starts (you're 7 hours ahead — use it)

Diary management: protect focus blocks, schedule calls, chase confirmations

Track open commitments — his and yours — and chase them until closed

End-of-day report: what shipped, what's stuck, what needs a decision

Ad-hoc research and document prep



The golden rule: you draft, he approves. Nothing is published or sent in the founder's name without his sign-off. As trust builds, you'll earn autonomy — but his voice is the asset, and we protect it.



MUST-HAVES



2+ years managing LinkedIn or social presence for a founder, executive, or personal brand — with results you can show

Exceptional written English. You'll be drafting in a UK founder's voice for an audience of UK business owners — samples will be required and tested

Canva proficiency (working to an existing brand guide)

Scheduling/analytics tools: Taplio, Hypefury, Buffer, Shield, or similar

Rock-solid discretion — you'll see deals, numbers, and conversations that stay private

Self-managing: you flag problems with a proposed fix, not just the problem

Stable internet, backup power/connection, quiet workspace



NICE-TO-HAVES



Qwoted, HARO/Connectively, or Featured pitching experience

Newsletter tools (Beehiiv, Substack, Mailchimp)

Basic video editing (CapCut/Descript) for repurposing

Zapier/Make/n8n

Experience supporting an executive's calendar and inbox



HOURS



Monday–Friday, 8 hours/day. Mostly your daytime (PH), but your shift must run until at least 6:00 PM Philippine time so we get a live handover during the UK morning. Weekends are yours.



PAY & BENEFITS



13th month pay

Paid Philippine public holidays + paid leave after probation

Performance review at 6 months with a raise path

Stable, long-term role with one employer



HOW TO APPLY



Attention to detail and writing ability ARE the job. So:



Put the word SIGNAL as the first word of your application.

Answer these three questions (short answers, no essays):



Link to a LinkedIn account or personal brand you've managed — or describe what you did and the results, with numbers.

Writing test: a business owner comments on one of our posts: "Interesting, but I'd never sell my company to an investor." Write the 2–3 sentence reply you'd draft for the founder.



What time (PH) would you prefer to start and finish?



Include a 2-minute Loom or video introducing yourself in English — talk about brands and executives you've supported, not your life story.



Attach your CV and 2–3 writing samples (posts, DMs, or pitches you've written for someone else).

You'll play a key role in planning product assortments, forecasting demand, managing inventory investment, and ensuring the right product is in the right place at the right time.

- Plan and execute store distribution strategies.

- Identify opportunities to improve sell-through and reduce excess inventory.

- Manage replenishment, allocations and store transfers where required.

- Monitor product performance from launch through markdown.

- Develop and execute markdown and promotional pricing strategies.

- Manage full-price and markdown stock consolidations.

- Identify underperforming products and recommend corrective actions.

- Ensure purchase orders are received accurately and managed through to completion.



Forecasting & Reporting

- Produce weekly and monthly trading reports.

- Present insights and recommendations to key stakeholders.

- Monitor core product forecasts and update plans regularly.

- Analyse store capacity and support inventory planning by location.



Collaboration

- Partner closely with Buying, Retail Operations, Logistics and Warehouse teams.

- Build strong relationships across the business.

- Contribute to process improvements and planning initiatives.

- Support new store openings through assortment planning.

- 2+ years' experience in Merchandise Planning within retail.

- Strong commercial acumen and understanding of retail financial metrics.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

- A proactive mindset with a continuous improvement approach.





What You'll Bring

- Strong understanding of sales, margin, inventory and forecasting.

- Ability to interpret data and translate it into commercial actions.

- High attention to detail.

- Confidence presenting recommendations to stakeholders.

- A collaborative, team-first approach.

- Self-motivation and the ability to work effectively in a remote environment.

When a property is sold at a foreclosure or tax sale for more than the amount owed, the extra money—called **surplus funds**—legally belongs to the former homeowner. Most never claim it because they are unaware of the process or do not understand how to retrieve it.



**Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC / Money Making CRM** specializes in helping families recover these funds. We are now opening our **Business Partnership Program** to qualified individuals in both the **United States and the Philippines** who want to operate their own surplus?funds business with full support from our firm.



This is **NOT employment**.  

This is a **business partnership**, and your earnings are based entirely on your own work, consistency, and results.



---

### **? Full Training & Onboarding**

s support your outreach

Our firm handles:

- All attorney communication  

- All legal paperwork  

- All court filings  

- All business fees  

- All contract preparation  



You focus ONLY on contacting potential clients. We handle everything else.



---



## **How Earnings Work**

This partnership operates on a **net?profit split model**.



### **1. Contract Pays Out**

When a surplus?funds case is successfully recovered, the payout is sent to our firm.



### **2. All Case?Related Fees Are Deducted**

Before any split is made, we deduct:

- Court filing fees  

- Attorney fees  

- Processing fees  

- VA/administrative fees  

- Any other case?related expenses  



These costs vary depending on the complexity of the case.



### **3. Net Profit Is Calculated**

After all fees are deducted, the remaining amount is the **net profit**.



### **4. Net Profit Is Split 50/50**

You receive **50% of the net profit**, and our firm receives the other 50%.



### **Typical Contract Values**

Most contracts range from **$8,000** to **hundreds of thousands of dollars**.

title: FOIA Researcher and Requester Needed for Fast-Growing Police Bodycam YouTube Channel
description:
We are a fast-growing police bodycam YouTube channel with a large and highly engaged audience, and we are looking for a reliable FOIA researcher and requester to join our team.



*If you don't have any previous FOIA experience do not apply for this role*



This role is not simply about knowing how to submit FOIA requests. The most important part of the job is being able to research and identify strong, relevant police cases that are likely to produce useful and engaging bodycam footage.



You will be expected to:



* Search news articles, police press releases, department websites, and police blotters for suitable cases

* Understand which cases are worth requesting and which are unlikely to produce useful footage

* Identify key case details, including the event date, location, suspect name, arrest date, charges, and report or case number

* Determine which police department or agency handled the case

* Use our provided FOIA template to submit accurate public records requests

* Find the correct public records portal or
 address for each department

* Keep all researched cases and submitted requests organized in a Google Sheet



Prior knowledge of FOIA or public records requests is required. Experience requesting police reports or body-worn camera footage is strongly preferred.



Fluent English is absolutely mandatory for this position. Applicants must be able to read and understand detailed English-language news articles, police reports, public records instructions, and written communication from law-enforcement agencies. You must also be able to write clearly and professionally when submitting requests or communicating with police departments. Applications from candidates who are not fluent in English will not be considered.



A short mandatory training period is required before beginning the role. The training will take place over three days and will total approximately four hours.



During the training, we will explain:



* How to find strong and relevant cases

* What makes a case suitable for a bodycam channel

* Which types of cases should be avoided

* How to verify important case details

* How to use our FOIA template

* How to submit requests through public records portals and

* How to organize and track your work correctly



The training is designed to ensure that you fully understand our process before working independently. Applicants should still have a basic understanding of FOIA and public records requests before applying.



Please understand that successfully submitting a request is only one part of the job. Our main focus is finding good cases. Sending a large number of requests is not useful if the cases are irrelevant, unlikely to have bodycam footage, or unsuitable for the channel.



Pay and Performance Bonuses:



The base pay for this position is $5 per hour, and payment is made weekly.



We strongly reward excellent work and place a major focus on quality. When a case you identify results in bodycam footage being obtained and that footage performs well on the channel, you may receive a performance bonus of up to $100 for that individual case.



Tea
mbers who consistently find high-quality cases, submit accurate requests, and help us obtain valuable footage will be rewarded accordingly. We greatly value people who produce strong results rather than simply submitting requests as quickly as possible.



A minimum of 250 properly researched and accurately submitted FOIA requests per month is required. However, meeting the minimum number alone is not enough. Every request must be based on a relevant case that has been properly researched and is reasonably likely to produce useful bodycam footage.



This position offers opportunities for both short-term and long-term work. Initial assignments may be offered on a short-term basis, with the possibility of ongoing long-term work for candidates who consistently find strong cases, submit accurate requests, follow instructions, and meet expectations.



We are looking for someone who is:



* Fluent in written and spoken English

* Strong at online research

* Able to identify interesting and relevant police cases

* Detail-oriented and reliable

* Familiar with public records portals

* Able to follow instructions carefully

* Organized and consistent

* Capable of submitting at least 250 quality requests per month

* Willing to complete the required training

* Focused on producing quality work and strong results



Please apply with a brief explanation of your previous FOIA or public records experience. Also explain how you would d
 whether a police case is suitable for a bodycam request.



Important application instruction: When messaging me, begin your application with the exact words “BWC Request.” This is required to confirm that you have fully read and understood the job listing. Applications that do not include “BWC Request” will not be considered.

title: Digital Marketing / Operations Manager (Growth Role — Uncapped Commission Upside)
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing / Operations Manager (Growth Role — Uncapped Commission Upside)

Salary: $5/hour · 20 hours/week to start · Weekly pay via PayPal · Plus 5% recurring commission on agency deals you close · Real path to grow into running the operation



About the Role



I run a growing digital marketing company with a portfolio of local and B2B brands, plus a full-service marketing agency. I'm looking for a sharp, organized jack-of-all-trades who can do three things: execute digital marketing work, coordinate our contractor team, and — for serious commission upside — help close new agency clients.



This is a real growth role. It starts at 20 hours a week, but for the right person it can grow into significantly more hours, more responsibility, and uncapped commission income. If you're ambitious and want to help build (and eventually help run) a real business — not just complete tasks — this is for you.



What You'll Do



Digital Marketing (your core skill):



Hands-on SEO, backlink building, content, and general digital marketing execution across our brands



You should be genuinely capable across multiple areas of digital marketing — a true generalist who can do the work, not just talk about it



Operations & Team Coordination:



Help manage our contractor team (backlink builders, SEO specialists) — track their output, review their work against our quality standards, keep projects moving



Keep our systems and workflows running so things don't fall through the cracks

Be the person who makes sure the day-to-day operation runs smoothly



Agency Sales (the big upside):



Help bring in new clients for our agency packages ($5,000–$15,000/month retainers)

Outreach, qualifying prospects, and — as you prove yourself — closing deals



You earn 5% recurring commission on every agency client you close, for as long as you're with us and the client stays. One $10,000/month client = $500/month in recurring commission to you, every month, on top of your base. Close a few and your commission can far exceed your salary. This is uncapped.



Who You Are



2+ years of real digital marketing experience — you can show me actual work and results (rankings, links, traffic, campaigns)



Genuinely a generalist — comfortable across SEO, links, content, and marketing strategy



Organized and reliable — you manage your time well and keep others on track



Strong written and spoken English — you'll communicate with me daily and potentially with clients



Some sales, outreach, or client-facing experience is a big plus (this is where the money is)



Ambitious — you want to grow into a leadership/operations role, not stay a task-taker



Comfortable with Ahrefs (or similar), Google Workspace, Slack, and spreadsheets



Hours, Pay & Growth



20 hours/week to start, roughly aligned with U.S. Central Time business hours for daily communication

$5/hour base, paid weekly

5% recurring commission on every agency deal you close — uncapped, and it compounds

Clear path to more hours, more responsibility, and running the operation as you prove yourself. I pay and promote based on results I can see.



How to Apply



 
 "Homely Media - Operations Manager" 



1. Your digital marketing experience — walk me through one project you owned and the actual result (with real numbers).

2. Have you managed or coordinated other people/contractors before? Tell me about it.

3. Have you ever sold anything, done outreach, or worked with clients directly? Even informally — I want to know if you have any sales instinct.

4. Why does the commission structure appeal to you? (I want to see if you're hungry.)

5. Confirm you can work ~20 hours/week with daily updates during U.S. Central hours, and send your IQ test score from 
/take-the-test/ (the free
ed score).



Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed. I'm looking for someone I can grow with — looking forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Tax Accountant
description:
OUR PROCESS FOR INTERVIEWING:



Our interview process is designed to ensure a mutual fit. It includes:



1) Initial Screening: Review of applications, resumes, and predictive index surveys (see below for details).

2) Video Interview: If requested, you will record and send us a video of your answers to a variety of questions.

3) First Interview: A conversation to understand your skills, experience and core values.

4) Second Interview: A deeper dive into your fit with our core values and role specifics. Meet the partners.

5) Additional interviews as needed

6) Skill Evaluation: We will give you a sample task to complete.

7) Final Evaluation: Decision-making and offer presentation.

______________________________________



BACKGROUND OF COMPANY:

One Stop Tax Strategists is co-founded by two sisters Tiffany and Melanie, inspired by their father Byron, a CPA with over 40 years of experience. Our company specializes in creative tax planning, preparation, bookkeeping, and payroll for entrepreneurs around the USA. Our client base is made up of about 70% real estate investors, spread across multiple US states. We are committed to helping our clients pay the least tax legally possible, enabling them to fund their dreams.



Our mission is to bring peace to taxes and purpose to profits to help our clients & team live more.

To get a feel for who we are, check out our website (
) and Instagram 
 

____________________________________________________



THE BEST APPLICANT WILL BE:

We are seeking a highly skilled CPA OR Tax Professional with a minimum of 5 years of UNITED STATES TAX experience (and specific real estate tax experience as bonus), who thrives in a professional, structured, and remote work environment. The ideal candidate is disciplined, detail-driven, sincere, and precise, bringing a strong sense of accountability to their work. We value professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality service. If you are a thorough, conscientious, and dedicated tax expert looking for a long-term opportunity, we’d love to hear from you!

_______________________________________________



START DAY/TIME:

We are not looking to have this position filled until the fall or end of 2026. However, if you are the right fit, we are open to starting you sooner.

_______________________________________________



POSITION DETAILS:

-Reports To: Senior Client Manager  

-Classification: Full-Time, Exempt  

-Client-Facing Role: No 

-Supervisory Responsibilities: Directly supervises the Offshore Production Team and Junior Tax Accountants.  

-Salary Range: $40,000-50,000 USD per year  

______________________________________________



POSITION SUMMARY:

-Directly supervise and develop the Offshore(PH) Production Team and Junior Tax Accountants. 

-Manage the production pipeline, including workload distribution, capacity planning, and deadline management. 

-Ensure work is completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with firm standards and procedures. 

-Monitor team performance, productivity, quality, and utilization metrics. 

-Provide coaching, training, accountability, and performance management for production tea
mbers. 

-Oversee production systems, workflows, and process improvements to increase efficiency and scalability. 

-Coordinate with Client Managers, reviewers, and firm leadership to ensure smooth engagement flow and timely delivery. 

-Maintain visibility into production capacity, staffing needs, and at-risk engagements, escalating concerns when necessary. 

____________________________________________________



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:



Production Workflow & Capacity Management:

-Receive production-ready engagements from the administrative team.  

-Assign tax returns, bookkeeping engagements, and related work to offshore staff based on complexity, due dates, capacity, and skill level.  

-Balance workload across the team to maximize efficiency and prevent bottlenecks.  

-Monitor the production pipeline to ensure engagements move through each stage on time.  

-Reassign and reprioritize work as deadlines, extensions, or urgent requests arise.  

-Maintain accurate production statuses and ownership within firm systems.  

-Monitor aging work and proactively address stalled engagements.



Team Leadership & Development:

-Directly supervise the Offshore Production Team and Junior Tax Accountants.  

-Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with tea
mbers.  

-Establish performance expectations and accountability standards.  

-Monitor productivity, utilization, turnaround times, and quality metrics.  

-Provide coaching, training, and ongoing professional development.  

-Conduct performance reviews and performance improvement plans when necessary.  

-Address performance concerns and recommend disciplinary action or termination when appropriate. 

-Identify staffing needs and participate in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring.  

-Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous learning, and excellence. 



Quality Control & Process Improvement:

-Perform first-level quality reviews before work is routed to reviewers or client managers.  

-Ensure compliance with firm procedures, checklists, and documentation standards.  

-Monitor recurring errors and identify training opportunities.  

-Coordinate corrective training and quality initiatives.  

-Maintain and improve production workflows, SOPs, and best practices.  

-Recommend process improvements to increase efficiency and accuracy. 



Production Reporting & Systems Administration: 

-Maintain real-time visibility into all production work.  

-Track and report production KPIs and team performance metrics.  

-Identify and escalate at-risk engagements and capacity concerns.  

-Manage production-related system access and permissions.  

-Ensure tasks, returns, and workflows are properly maintained within TaxDome, Lacerte, and QuickBooks Online.  

-Troubleshoot workflow issues and coordinate resolution of system-related problems. 



Systems & Documentation:

-Maintain client records in TaxDome, Lacerte, and QuickBooks Online.  

-Document client interactions and decisions.  

-Update engagement statuses and notes.  

-Manage client portal access and document organization.  

_____________________________________



What This Role Does NOT Do :

-Does not communicate directly with clients.  

-Does not manage client onboarding, billing, or engagement administration.  

-Does not deliver completed returns to clients.  

-Does not perform final tax review or sign-off when reserved for licensed reviewers or partners.

_______________________________________



CORE VALUES:

- Integrity in words and actions: be honest, tell the truth, and do what you say you're going to do - even when it's hard

- We're candid with care: honest in our feedback, kind in our delivery, and curious before we judge

- We own our work and our outcomes: admitting mistakes, asking for help, and following through on what we say

- Better today than yesterday: always learning, expanding our strengths, and growing through our weaknesses, both personally and professionally

- We're one team: we step up, help each other, and put the team first.

______________________________________



NEXT STEPS:



Thank you for your interest in starting a new career with One Stop Tax Strategists. As part of our interview process, we ask that you:

2) Complete a Predictive Index survey:

--> It is incredibly easy and only takes about 6 minutes to complete.

--> Please work on a desktop or laptop and not on your smart phone.

In this role, you will be responsible for triaging security alerts, conducting in-depth investigations, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and recommending or executing remediation steps. You'll work across a modern security stack including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, FortiGate, Netskope, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM - and you'll leverage AI-assisted analysis tools (including Claude) to accelerate investigation and response.



This is a hands-on, technically rigorous role for someone who thrives on solving puzzles, communicating clearly under pressure, and constantly leveling up their security craft.



Key Responsibilities



Alert Triage & Monitoring

Monitor security alerts and events across Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365), Netskope, FortiGate firewalls, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM.

Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: validate fidelity, classify severity, assign priority, and determine whether an alert is a true positive, false positive, or benign true positive.

Acknowledge, document, and escalate alerts per defined SLAs and runbooks.

Maintain situational awareness across multiple client environments, tenants, and Azure stack workloads (AVD, Azure VMs, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure networking).



Investigation & Root Cause Analysis

Conduct detailed investigations into security i
 — pivoting across logs, endpoint telemetry, network flows, identity signals, and user activity to build a full picture of what happened.

Construct timelines of events, identify the initial access vector, lateral movement, and impact.

Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to determine the underlying conditions that allowed an i
 to occur (misconfiguration, missing control, user behavior, vulnerability, etc.).

Use Microsoft Sentinel KQL queries to hunt across log sources, build investigations, and validate hypotheses.

Leverage AI-assisted tools (including Claude) to accelerate log analysis, summarize findings, draft queries, and support investigation workflows - while maintaining analyst judgment and validation.



Response & Next Steps

Recommend and, where authorized, execute containment and remediation actions (isolating endpoints, disabling accounts, blocking IOCs at the firewall or proxy, revoking sessions, etc.).

Coordinate with Tier 3 / IR specialists and client-facing teams to hand off complex i
 with complete context.

Document clear, actionable next steps for clients — including technical remediation, policy changes, user education, and follow-up validation.

Produce concise, professional i
 write-ups suitable for both technical and non-technical client audiences.



Continuous Improvement

Tune detection rules and analytics in Sentinel and Defender to reduce false positives and improve signal quality.

Contribute to and maintain SOC runbooks, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.

Identify recurring i
 patterns and recommend systemic improvements (control gaps, configuration drift, training opportunities).

Stay current on threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to client environments.



Required Qualifications

Experience: 1–3+ years in a SOC, NOC with security responsibilities, MSP/MSSP, IT security, or similar hands-on role.

SIEM: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including writing and tuning KQL queries.

Microsoft Security Stack: Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, O365) and Azure AD / Entra ID.

Azure: Familiarity with Azure stack components — Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Azure VMs, Azure networking, and core IAM concepts.

Network Security: Practical experience reading FortiGate firewall logs, policies, and traffic flows.

Endpoint & Cloud Tools: Exposure to Netskope (SWG/CASB), ObserveIT (or similar UAM/insider risk), NinjaRMM (or comparable RMM), and Auvik (or comparable network monitoring).

Investigation Skills: Demonstrated ability to perform structured triage, root cause analysis, and produce clear i
 documentation.

Foundations: Solid grasp of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), authentication protocols, common attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK), and Windows event logs.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication — able to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Mindset: Curiosity, attention to detail, and the discipline to follow process without losing the ability to think critically.



Preferred Qualifications

Industry certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, SC-200, SC-900, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, or equivalent.

Experience in an MSP or MSSP environment supporting multiple client tenants.

Scripting / automation experience (PowerShell, Python, KQL functions, Logic Apps, Sentinel playbooks).

Experience integrating or working with AI-assisted security tooling (e.g., Claude, Security Copilot) for investigation and reporting workflows.

Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, EDR forensic workflows, and basic malware triage.

Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, SOC 2).



What You'll Get

A modern, well-instrumented security stack with real depth across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud.

Direct exposure to a wide variety of environments and i
 types — accelerated growth vs. a single-enterprise SOC.

Access to AI-assisted tooling that augments (not replaces) your analytical work.

Clear mentorship from senior analysts and a defined progression path from Tier 1 to Tier 2 and beyond.

Support for certifications and ongoing training.



Working Conditions

This role may include shift work or on-call rotation to support SOC coverage requirements.

Remote, hybrid, or onsite arrangements per AlphaRidge policy.

AlphaRidge is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
# **Surplus Funds Business Partnership Program**  (Spots are limited)

### *Powered by Money Making CRM & Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC*



## **Program Overview**

The Surplus Funds Industry is one of the most profitable and overlooked sectors in the United States. When a property is sold at a foreclosure or tax sale for more than the amount owed, the extra money—called **surplus funds**—legally belongs to the former homeowner. Most never claim it because they are unaware of the process or do not understand how to retrieve it.



**Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC / Money Making CRM** specializes in helping families recover these funds. We are now opening our **Business Partnership Program** to qualified individuals in both the **United States and the Philippines** who want to operate their own surplus?funds business with full support from our firm.



This is **NOT employment**.  

This is a **business partnership**, and your earnings are based entirely on your own work, consistency, and results.



---



## **What We Provide**

### **? Full Training & Onboarding**

We teach you the surplus?funds business from start to finish, including:

- How to locate potential clients  

- How to communicate with homeowners  

- How to use our CRM  

- How the legal recovery process works  



### **? Money Making CRM Access**

You receive access to our CRM where:

- Leads are loaded daily  

- You make calls directly inside the system  

- Automated texts and
s support your outreach  

- Our team manages all backend operations  



### **? Full Legal & Administrative Support**

Our firm handles:

- All attorney communication  

- All legal paperwork  

- All court filings  

- All business fees  

- All contract preparation  



You focus ONLY on contacting potential clients. We handle everything else.



---



## **How Earnings Work**

This partnership operates on a **net?profit split model**.



### **1. Contract Pays Out**

When a surplus?funds case is successfully recovered, the payout is sent to our firm.



### **2. All Case?Related Fees Are Deducted**

Before any split is made, we deduct:

- Court filing fees  

- Attorney fees  

- Processing fees  

- VA/administrative fees  

- Any other case?related expenses  



These costs vary depending on the complexity of the case.



### **3. Net Profit Is Calculated**

After all fees are deducted, the remaining amount is the **net profit**.



### **4. Net Profit Is Split 50/50**

You receive **50% of the net profit**, and our firm receives the other 50%.



### **Typical Contract Values**

Most contracts range from **$8,000** to **hundreds of thousands of dollars**.  

This is a **pipeline business** — payouts can take **30 days up to 12 months**, depending on the case.



### **How You Get Paid**

Once your portion is ready:

- Filipino partners are paid through **Remitly**  

- U.S. partners are paid via **direct deposit**  



---



## **Who We Approve**

This program is **selective**.  

We only partner with individuals who:

- Communicate professionally  

- Follow instructions  

- Are consistent with outreach  

- Show integrity and respect for clients  

- Demonstrate the ability to operate as a business partner, not an employee  



We reserve the right to approve only those who meet our standards.



---



## **What This Program Is NOT**

- ? Not a job  

- ? Not hourly pay  

- ? Not a VA position  

- ? Not guaranteed income  



This is a **business partnership**, and your earnings depend on your effort, consistency, and ability to build a pipeline.



---



## **How to Apply**

To be considered, submit the following:

- **Your resume**  

- **A short video or voice message** introducing yourself  

- **Your
 address** so we can send you the intro video explaining the business model  



Once reviewed, our team will contact you if you qualify for partnership.

 marketing
